Elissa Slotkin for Congresshttps://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220720 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220720]
It’s one of my favorite days of the year: it’s National Hot Dog Day, people!
Didn’t have this one marked on your calendar? Well, I don’t blame you — but I do want to explain why it’s so important to me. Watch below:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220720 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220720]
Hot dogs are a huge part of my family’s history. My great-grandfather immigrated to the United States, got into the meatpacking business, and eventually founded the family business: Hygrade Foods. It’s a business that would go on to do all the meat for Nathan’s Hot Dogs for the first 50 years AND invent the Ball Park Frank, first sold at Tiger Stadium.
It’s our family's piece of the American dream. And our hot dog legacy carries on every time the Slotkins get together and grill some hot dogs (or Slot-dogs, as we call them).

Every woman deserves the right to abortion care regardless of where she lives. Now that the Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade, Kim is working in Congress to ensure women in every state can plan their pregnancies, protect their health, and chart the course of their lives. | **House passes bills to codify abortion rights and ensure access**

"The House on Friday passed legislation that would protect access to reproductive health care, including the ability to travel across state lines for an abortion, as part of Democrats’ efforts to minimize the consequences of the Supreme Court overturning _Roe v. Wade_ last month."
---

Peter,

Every woman deserves the right to abortion care regardless of where she lives. Now that the Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , Kim is working in Congress to ensure women in every state can plan their pregnancies, protect their health, and chart the course of their lives.

**Last week, Kim was proud to help pass the two bills in the House that will ensure access to abortion for all women.** With women in more than half the states losing access to abortion care at home, these bills protect women who cross state lines to receive abortion care, and it protects health care providers who provide abortions to out-of-state patients.

Peter – when and whether to become a mother is the single most important decision a woman will ever make. As the only pro-choice woman doctor in Congress, Kim knows this deeply personal decision should be between a woman and her doctor only. The government has no place in the exam room.

Kim will always fight to ensure access to reproductive health care is guaranteed for every woman in every state, but now we need the Senate to act and pass these crucial bills.

name: Finstad for Congress - Press
subject: FINSTAD CAMPAIGN RELEASES TELEVISION AND RADIO ADS IN RUN UP TO SPECIAL ELECTION ON TUESDAY, AUGUST 9
body:
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
CONTACT: press@finstadforcongress.com
Wednesday, July 20, 2022**FINSTAD CAMPAIGN RELEASES TELEVISION AND RADIO ADS IN RUN UP TO SPECIAL ELECTION ON TUESDAY, AUGUST 9****New Ulm, MN****** - The Finstad for Congress Campaign today released television and radio ads in the run up to the Special General Election on Tuesday, August 9.The television and radio ads highlight Brad Finstad's agricultural background as a farmer and his roots in the 1st Congressional District and provides voters with a contrast between Finstad and his opponent, Jeff Ettinger, who has donated thousands of dollars to Democrats and supports the Biden-Pelosi agenda. "Minnesota families have been devastated by the Biden-Pelosi policies. Minnesotans cannot afford to pay more for gas, food, necessities and more government spending. It is time for change in Washington, D.C. and that's what we'll deliver when we win on Tuesday, August 9," said Finstad.Link to Television Ad: [https://youtu.be/xl4dOsWxkGw](https://finsb-finstadforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-aldjlld-jrhhjlljll-r/)Link to Radio Ad: [https://youtu.be/DposKcVbQUg](https://finsb-finstadforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-aldjlld-jrhhjlljll-y/) _###__**About Brad Finstad** : _Brad Finstad is a family farmer, former State Representative and President Trump's appointee as Minnesota Director of the U.S. Department of Agriculture. His family has farmed the same land near New Ulm for four generations and he and his wife Jackie operate the farm and have seven children. Finstad won the Special Primary Election on May 24 and is the Republican nominee for the Special Election and the Republican-endorsed candidate for the Primary Election on August 9.Brad is a graduate of the University of Minnesota with a degree in Agriculture Education with an emphasis in Rural Leadership Development. He and his wife Jackie met on the school bus in second grade. Today they are proud parents of seven parents. clean_body: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE CONTACT: press@finstadforcongress.com Wednesday, July 20, 2022FINSTAD CAMPAIGN RELEASES TELEVISION AND RADIO ADS IN RUN UP TO SPECIAL ELECTION ON TUESDAY, AUGUST 9New Ulm, MN** - The Finstad for Congress Campaign today released television and radio ads in the run up to the Special General Election on Tuesday, August 9.The television and radio ads highlight Brad Finstad's agricultural background as a farmer and his roots in the 1st Congressional District and provides voters with a contrast between Finstad and his opponent, Jeff Ettinger, who has donated thousands of dollars to Democrats and supports the Biden-Pelosi agenda. "Minnesota families have been devastated by the Biden-Pelosi policies. Minnesotans cannot afford to pay more for gas, food, necessities and more government spending. It is time for change in Washington, D.C. and that's what we'll deliver when we win on Tuesday, August 9," said Finstad.Link to Television Ad: to Radio Ad: ###About Brad Finstad** : _Brad Finstad is a family farmer, former State Representative and President Trump's appointee as Minnesota Director of the U.S. Department of Agriculture. His family has farmed the same land near New Ulm for four generations and he and his wife Jackie operate the farm and have seven children. Finstad won the Special Primary Election on May 24 and is the Republican nominee for the Special Election and the Republican-endorsed candidate for the Primary Election on August 9.Brad is a graduate of the University of Minnesota with a degree in Agriculture Education with an emphasis in Rural Leadership Development. He and his wife Jackie met on the school bus in second grade. Today they are proud parents of seven parents. | |

subject: re: the 6-week abortion ban

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek —

Earlier today, the courts finalized Brian
Kemp’s extreme and dangerous abortion ban. Now in Georgia, abortion care
is a crime after six weeks of pregnancy, before many women even know
they’re pregnant.

Brian Kemp achieved his goal: to endanger women, strip away our right to
choose and deny our ability to make medical decisions.

Under Kemp, Georgia is at or near the bottom on nearly every health care
measure — from doctor and nursing shortages, to maternal and infant
deaths, to the shuttering of three hospitals during the pandemic. This new
law will only make it worse.

While Brian Kemp’s six-week abortion ban has taken over three years to
take effect, the impact is clear: women are now second-class citizens in
Kemp’s Georgia.

That’s why right now, I am asking you to make a donation to a group of
organizations protecting critical reproductive rights and reproductive
choice work in Georgia and across the region. In the aftermath of Kemp’s
six-week abortion ban, we need to support the people providing the care
and doing the work right now.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1526?refcode=sa_em_220720_B4_Org_S1_T1_SYA_T1-T2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=1083%2E1862389%2E_VJjaj ]Please join me in supporting Feminist Women’s Health Center,
SisterSong, ARC Southeast, Planned Parenthood Southeast and NARAL
Pro-Choice Georgia by splitting a donation to these groups today:

* Planned Parenthood Southeast is the Planned Parenthood affiliate
representing Georgia, Alabama and Mississippi.
* Feminist Women’s Health Center works to advance reproductive health,
rights and justice through community education, grassroots organizing,
public affairs and advocacy programs in Georgia.
* SisterSong is a Southern-based, national membership organization whose
purpose is to build an effective network of individuals and
organizations to improve institutional policies and systems that
impact the reproductive lives of marginalized communities.
* Access Reproductive Care (ARC) Southeast provides funding and
logistical support to ensure Southerners receive safe and
compassionate reproductive care including abortion services.
* NARAL Pro-Choice Georgia is the grassroots pro-choice advocacy
organization in Georgia fighting for reproductive freedom for all.

Derek, in the
days ahead, remember that we are in this fight together. Believe in our
ability to overcome. And know that together, if we unite, good will be
won.

Sincerely,

Stacey

It passed the House, despite the opposition of 157 of Obernolte’s fellow Republicans. Now, it’s in the Senate.

| Vernon's Road Ahead
\- July 21st, 2022 - Hey Friends,
As you all may already know, I have spent the past two years trying to grow the Republican Party in Georgia. I recently participated in both Georgia's gubernatorial election and the congressional race for Georgia's 10th district. Although we didn't achieve our intended results, I am so thankful for the support that all of you gave me on this journey. I have learned a lot, and I will take those lessons with me moving forward.
In the past, I served the people of Georgia as a member of the state's House of Representatives and as the County Executive of DeKalb County - as a conservative Democrat in both positions. My goal was to always fight for conservative principles, even if my party disagreed. However, during President Trump's reelection campaign in 2020, I was inspired to do more. I saw how hard President Trump fought for the American people, and I felt that my calling was to follow in his footsteps. That is exactly why I endorsed President Trump against the will of my party and even spoke at the Republican National Convention that summer.
As a supporter of President Trump and the MAGA movement, I understood that I was no longer welcome in the Democratic Party - or as I like to call it, the "mental plantation." Democrats persecuted and ostracized me because I dared to think for myself. On more than one occasion, I came face to face with angry violent mobs. I eventually reached a breaking point and decided to join the Republican Party. I left the party of the Ku Klux Klan and Joe Biden and joined the party of Abraham Lincoln, Frederick Douglass, Herschel Walker, Ronald Reagan, and Donald Trump. When Democrats turned their back on me, my choice was easy.
My ultimate goal when running for a greater office was to grow the GOP. As we saw with President Trump in the 2020 election, the Republican Party has grown more multiracial and diverse under his bold leadership. My goal was to ensure that trend continued and help Republicans reach out to America's black men and women. They know that Democrats have ignored them for decades. We just need to reach out and let them know that Republicans are there for them. We are the party of liberty and economic prosperity. Although my campaign is over, the America First movement is still alive. I intend to use every tool at my disposal to help the GOP and President Trump grow the Republican Party. We need to ensure that Republicans retake Congress later this year and that a Republican wins the presidential election in 2024 - with that Republican hopefully being President Trump if he decides to run again.
Where does Vernon go from here? I have joined an exciting platform called Locals. Here you can get exclusive newsletters, op-eds, and videos directly from me that you can't get anywhere else. This train is about to take off. [Go there now and subscribe! ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-IXtgpOs_pEQx9qg10eJkDSRI6PiovijiQi_Nf1MlcUD4AMSoCRGdRzcP-YqKdTqzQQet8EjuFGYSbrQmuinKZox-AYwP6r1zWgsyI_JFzGhhWI_FA5MVBy9z738S77N_EPqNE5mJAGz6EY9U-TwzErHNmvJuUbv&c=_QSYIKgov_lClWQpQ3JLFBLncYbOY2PJK9TmpTTP2kbSVtYmpQh9jw==&ch=FWZKc9I7y1v1vYuMshCscdsqTWgYEggRuTz-b2Yxq1KsXn3Iv2_ICg==)
Once again, I would like to thank all of you for supporting me on this journey. I couldn't have done it without all your prayers, love, and support. Stay tuned! Buckle up, the best is yet to come!
Have a blessed day, Vernon Jones

clean_body: | | | | | | Vernon's Road Ahead \- July 21st, 2022 - Hey Friends, As you all may already know, I have spent the past two years trying to grow the Republican Party in Georgia. I recently participated in both Georgia's gubernatorial election and the congressional race for Georgia's 10th district. Although we didn't achieve our intended results, I am so thankful for the support that all of you gave me on this journey. I have learned a lot, and I will take those lessons with me moving forward. In the past, I served the people of Georgia as a member of the state's House of Representatives and as the County Executive of DeKalb County - as a conservative Democrat in both positions. My goal was to always fight for conservative principles, even if my party disagreed. However, during President Trump's reelection campaign in 2020, I was inspired to do more. I saw how hard President Trump fought for the American people, and I felt that my calling was to follow in his footsteps. That is exactly why I endorsed President Trump against the will of my party and even spoke at the Republican National Convention that summer. As a supporter of President Trump and the MAGA movement, I understood that I was no longer welcome in the Democratic Party - or as I like to call it, the "mental plantation." Democrats persecuted and ostracized me because I dared to think for myself. On more than one occasion, I came face to face with angry violent mobs. I eventually reached a breaking point and decided to join the Republican Party. I left the party of the Ku Klux Klan and Joe Biden and joined the party of Abraham Lincoln, Frederick Douglass, Herschel Walker, Ronald Reagan, and Donald Trump. When Democrats turned their back on me, my choice was easy. My ultimate goal when running for a greater office was to grow the GOP. As we saw with President Trump in the 2020 election, the Republican Party has grown more multiracial and diverse under his bold leadership. My goal was to ensure that trend continued and help Republicans reach out to America's black men and women. They know that Democrats have ignored them for decades. We just need to reach out and let them know that Republicans are there for them. We are the party of liberty and economic prosperity. Although my campaign is over, the America First movement is still alive. I intend to use every tool at my disposal to help the GOP and President Trump grow the Republican Party. We need to ensure that Republicans retake Congress later this year and that a Republican wins the presidential election in 2024 - with that Republican hopefully being President Trump if he decides to run again. Where does Vernon go from here? I have joined an exciting platform called Locals. Here you can get exclusive newsletters, op-eds, and videos directly from me that you can't get anywhere else. This train is about to take off. == Once again, I would like to thank all of you for supporting me on this journey. I couldn't have done it without all your prayers, love, and support. Stay tuned! Buckle up, the best is yet to come! body:
Biden is blundering our country towards the abyss
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z23cj3d3iuos9n4gj5ilu6vgadrfjeepa8u2bjao_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5g62o72cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqcdtjmpqj4srk65qb6t9j6toj79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onncuqeep3mc5gj4shi6cq3dcjgspgm4ddmcjj6aodmcjg71dhmccqn2phi66p31puie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74c36eljj6oj7mth6cc9gm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
**[](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z6b0f6nhmokppkj6ggauocada6tk0rah09i110eg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5g62o72cdh2bs)**
Friend,
When I was elected Governor in 2018, there were nearly 300,000 more Democrats than Republicans registered in the state of Florida.

I was not elected by a landslide - far from it, actually. I was elected because of the hard work of dedicated grassroots supporters who saw that the idea of freedom was under attack in America. I was elected _by them and by the grace of God._

**Can you imagine how different our state would be right now if freedom had not won in 2018?** Over the last three and a half years, Florida has cemented its place as a beachhead of freedom. Florida is a shining example that no matter the circumstances, freedom is always a working model.

We are the state that didn't turn to tyranny in the face of uncertainty. We led with freedom and empowered our citizens - just as the Founders intended.

As I write to you today, Republicans continue to outpace Democrats in voter registration -_and we 're not looking back!_ **We are on track for a HUGE RED WAVE this November, and we must turn up the pressure.**

Ten years ago, I decided to run for Congress because I believed the Obama administration was leading in a way which was totally inconsistent with the founding of our great country.

Now, Biden is enacting an agenda that may exceed the destruction of the old Obama agenda. **The radical Left in this country is more aggressive than ever before.** They no longer conceal that they are committed to destroying America from within.

Rewriting history, support of cultural Marxism, indoctrination rather than education, and sexually explicit material in the classroom with young children - _these are days I never imagined seeing in my country and days I refuse to let take hold in Florida._

**Biden is blundering our country towards the abyss and make no mistake: They 're coming for Florida because Florida represents a roadblock for the Biden agenda.**

As long as I am Governor, Florida will continue to be that beachhead of freedom for the rest of the nation, and world, to follow.

I need your support to continue this uphill battle for the future of our state. _**_[Can I count on you to stand with me on the side of freedom and secure the free future of Florida?](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zhqnbmvdm41ed1b83mdlmjbu6ol0ucebcuug4nco_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5g62o72cdh2bs "Can I count on you to stand with me on the side of freedom and secure the free future of Florida?")_**_

Friend, did you hear what the AG said?
In a recent Twitter Spaces with Democracy Docket and election lawyer Marc Elias, A.G. Holder spoke about the United States Supreme Court’s decision to hear _Moore_ , the independent state legislature theory (ISL) case, and other prevalent redistricting news. Here’s how the AG put it:
* North Carolina Republicans are using ISL, a truly fringe legal theory, to attack our democracy and desperately hold onto political power
* Republican maps are so unfair to voters of color that even Trump-appointed judges in Alabama struck down a GOP congressional map (The Supreme Court reinstated that map for 2022 and is now considering letting it stand for the decade in _Merrill v. Caster_).
* We are moving towards a system of political apartheid

[**Maps preferred by Republicans, in states like Alabama and North Carolina, are antidemocratic, gerrymandered, and disenfranchise voters of color. Republican-controlled state legislatures will draw these maps all across the country if they win _Moore_ and _Caster_. We cannot express how dangerous this case could be to fair redistricting efforts and to American democracy. body:
Her donations come from PAC money, corporate donations, and most come from out-of-state interests. Her low number shows a lack of local enthusiasm. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/thelanderforcongress/q2-fundraising-numbers?e=f8a0a76a2b)
---
[](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=3e9f382d4f&e=f8a0a76a2b)
**1st District Congressional Candidate Thelander Out Raises Pingree Nearly 3-to-1 Among Maine Contributors**
Bristol, Maine, July 21, 2022 – Ed Thelander, Republican candidate for Maine’s 1st Congressional District, today announced that he has outraised his opponent Congresswoman Chellie Pingree when it comes to individual Maine donors. A breakdown of [donations by state](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=b1ee0f06c0&e=f8a0a76a2b) shows that Pingree, who has held this seat for 14 years, has only collected a total of $50,938 from Maine residents over the course of her 2022 re-election bid. Thelander, who is making his first run for elected office, has raised $140,848 from supporters who call Maine home.Thelander is also raising more money from individual donations than Pingree, with total individual contributions for the two coming in at $244,754 and $210,300, respectively. “We didn’t come into this race with a magic money list”, Thelander said. “This is a clear indicator that voters are eager for change and accountability in government. Our message is resonating with Mainers who no longer feel represented and are disappointed with Congress. They feel Pingree just doesn’t care about them.”Thelander, a 21-year veteran of the Navy SEAL Teams, emphasized that, “Nearly half of her donations come from PAC money, corporate donations, and as we now know, most come from out-of-state interests. Her relatively low number shows a lack of local enthusiasm. Our strength has been the many small donations from people we meet while crisscrossing the 1st District.”Executive Director of the Maine Republican Party Jason Savage stated, “We are seeing tremendous enthusiasm and optimism in the 1st Congressional District around Ed’s candidacy. Ed likes to say that a Red Wave won’t happen unless we make it happen. These fundraising numbers show that Ed is working to create that wave, and that his message is resonating with the voters of Maine.”A closer look at the numbers shows that Pingree has raked in more than ten times the amount from PACs and committee transfers than Thelander, indicating that she represents corporate donors and not Maine people. “A $5 donation from a struggling lobsterman, a farmer whose future is uncertain, or a retiree who lives on a fixed income in a time of rising inflation means a whole lot more to me than $5,000 in special interest money ever will”, added Thelander.The full reports for the two campaigns are available to view [here for Pingree](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=46715d5a69&e=f8a0a76a2b), and [here for Thelander](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=4af21e34e7&e=f8a0a76a2b).If you haven’t yet, and want to join the effort to make the Red Wave happen, or if you want to step up again, click the donate button and add to the list of individual donors who have had enough of Pingree’s absentee representation. We aren’t doing this with corporate money, and we can’t do this without your help! Together let’s make things right!

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous
tax-deductible gift today.

And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll
send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our
thank you.

This hat commemorates our partnership with
USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best
American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and
Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited!

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second
Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take
our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will
only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve
liberty for future generations. Thank you!

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

| | Peter,

To be honest, I’m kind of worried.

Yesterday we reached out about a critical push to get grassroots supporters engaged in the fight to keep Georgia blue.

This past Friday candidates had to share their second quarter fundraising, and I’m proud that our campaign raised another six figures. Unlike others in this race, we are counting on grassroots supporters, not personal loans.
If you can lend your campaign tens or hundreds of thousands of dollars, I don’t think you’re worrying about the same things as the rest of us. To beat Allan Fung we need a candidate who’s from here, who lives here, and who understands the challenges people face every day.
Since day one, our campaign has been fueled by generous contributions from our supporters. Would you consider donating to the campaign right now so we can continue to grow our grassroots support? [https://joyfoxcongress.com/donate-to-joy-fox-for-congress/]
I know how rising prices impact families every day, what it means to have access to good healthcare and caregiver support for loved ones, and how people just want things to work better.
I've spent my career listening and working to help people right here in Rhode Island.
That's the experience I'll take to Washington when I’m the first Democratic woman elected to represent the Second District.
Thank you for your support,
Joy

subject: California or Florida?
body:

Peter, Over the past three years, **we have been called to make choices and answer questions we did not expect.**

Questions about how, in a world that seemed frightening and different, we were going to raise our kids, continue to put food on the table, and care for our communities?

And questions that feel further out now like, how does our government interact with its citizenry in a time of crisis?

How is our government -- one of the people, by the people, for the people -- meant to protect life, but not stifle liberty?

_In crisis, do we foster freedom? Or do we force our citizens down?_

Well, over the past three years I believe we have had the truth revealed about those two vastly different approaches. Not in an academic textbook or in a theoretical debate, but in the harsh reality of governing during COVID. You could not find two more starkly different examples than the free state of Florida and the woke tyranny of Gavin Newsom's California.

It isn't hard to understand why the Governor of California wants to talk about Florida. It's part of the one topic he tries to focus on: _**Anything but California.**_

Let's take a look at the record of the "liberal elite" in California:
1. They locked their kids out of public schools at the behest of the teachers' unions.
2. They forced small businesses to close with many never to re-open again.
3. They hobbled law enforcement and allowed drugs and crime to destroy their cities.

Everything on that list is a tragedy, and it's only made worse by the disregard and disrespect shown by leaders like Gavin Newsom. The idea of locking down your citizens and then darting off to the fanciest restaurant in the state to rub their noses in it.

It's wrong, it's disgusting, and it's no surprise that every day driving around Florida I see more and more California license plates as a result.

**In Florida, we didn't bludgeon our people with government mandates; we lifted people up -- protecting their jobs, their businesses, and their kids' education.**
**[Help us keep Florida free in November>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60846289:JTXh9QVNN:m:1:3253819041:2231C5D231836DA4694A9FD32BAA3857:r "Help us keep Florida free
in November >>>")**
We didn't lock business owners out of their livelihoods and we didn't lock people out of their jobs.

**In Florida we didn't turn a blind eye to crime and drugs, we put criminals behind bars, and we kept our streets safe.**

Gavin Newsom doesn't want to talk about California, and I don't blame him. But the reality is, there are plenty of woke liberal billionaires on Gavin Newsom's speed dial who do not want to see individual freedom succeed. **_They don't want to see it succeed in Florida or anywhere else._**

Because if it succeeds, it shows everyone that the top down nanny-state tyranny of California is avoidable -- Free people making their own decisions are better off than a locked down citizenry dictated to by elitists.

That's why I need your help. Gavin Newsom, funded by Hollywood liberals, Big Tech billionaires, and who knows who else is running ads in Florida. _**I need your help to fight back.**_ **On our side are free people who care to stay that way. On their side is everyone who thinks they know better.**

**Show them that we intend to stay free: [Make a donation right now](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60846289:JTXh9QVNN:m:1:3253819041:2231C5D231836DA4694A9FD32BAA3857:r "Make a donation right now") to help us fight back. You can use this** **[secure link](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60846289:JTXh9QVNN:m:1:3253819041:2231C5D231836DA4694A9FD32BAA3857:r "secure link")**.

Sincerely,__

Peter,

Yesterday, a federal court ruled that HB 481 — which will ban abortions in Georgia after six weeks of pregnancy — can take effect.

This wasn't unexpected after _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, but this news is still hard to take. This law will hurt healthcare providers and working-class families. It's going to open the door for unjust prosecutions of women. And it absolutely violates the right to privacy provided within the Georgia State Constitution.

Back in 1983, **I answered a call to serve because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm.** And while I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician.

But the problem is that some voters have only heard Marco Rubio's lies about me, and I need more resources to share my story of service with more Floridians before it's too late. Please understand, friend: How quickly I'm able to correct the record for voters will make or break this election.

**I graduated not only as class president, but at the top of my class.** When I got out of the academy, I went straight to work protecting and serving my community. And after decades of service, **I became the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.**
Fast-forward to today: I'm about to take on my biggest challenge yet. There are obstacles ahead, but with my "never tire" attitude and a massive grassroots movement behind me, I know that I can become Florida's next U.S. senator and expand our Democratic Senate majority.

**I'm no stranger to adversity, friend. If naysayers like Rubio think their attacks will make me feel defeated, they've got another thing coming. I've heard it all before – and I've only come out stronger.**
Thank you for joining this grassroots movement.

Sender: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220721rollingstone?refcode=lpfe220721rollingstone_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220721rollingstone?refcode=lpfe220721rollingstone_m]
It is almost too hard to imagine, but it’s true.
Extreme lawmakers in Texas and elsewhere are threatening to take away our constitutional right to travel freely between the states, and threatening people and organizations that are helping women travel out of state for abotion care.
Over the last week, I have heard many people say it just can’t possibly be true as they try to visualize a world where you need a negative pregnancy test to board a plane or drive across the state line. But it is true. And it is not a secret.
Extreme Texas lawmakers are publicizing their threats to companies, claiming they are subject to felony criminal prosecution for HR policies that reimburse their employees for out-of-state travel for abortion care and have outlined legislation they intend to bring to criminalize.
I’m going to do everything I can to protect our reproductive freedom, including the freedom to travel for the care we need. And I am proud to tell you that the House of Representatives has already responded to this effort by passing my bill to protect the right to travel for abortion care last week.
It’s so important that people know the real stakes in November’s election, and what is really happening in the ground in Texas.
Lizzie’s email earlier this week about her efforts to protect our constitutional right to travel for reproductive health care (and everything else) also highlighted a worrying trend – Republican leaders denying the undeniable facts.
This Rolling Stone article lays it out. Check out the article and help us spread the word by sharing it.
https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/texas/article/House-passes-abortion-legislation-led-by-Houston-17307908.php [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/texas/article/House-passes-abortion-legislation-led-by-Houston-17307908.php]

The Orwellian future that lawmakers in Texas and elsewhere are proposing is fundamentally contrary to our values as Texans and Americans. But we have a lot of work to do to ensure their vision does not become our future. There is no simple, quick solution. In a state where the legislative districts are gerrymandered, and where statewide elected officials are working every day to make this vision a reality, we need a sustained, systemic, strategic effort to take back our state from extremists who don’t represent the majority of Texans, and don’t care what they think.
That’s why we must continue our work, on this campaign and campaigns across the state. We are working now on plans to turn out the vote in TX-07, and to elect the leaders our community and our country deserve. I’m so grateful to know I can count on you to do this with us.
Together, we can do anything,

Lizzie’s email earlier this week about her efforts to protect our constitutional right to travel for reproductive health care (and everything else) also highlighted a worrying trend – Republican leaders denying the undeniable facts. This Rolling Stone article lays it out. Check out the article and help us spread the word by sharing it. READ HERE [] Thanks, Team Lizzie DONATE [] ------------------Original Message------------------ Sender: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher Date: July 18, 2022 [] It is almost too hard to imagine, but it’s true. Extreme lawmakers in Texas and elsewhere are threatening to take away our constitutional right to travel freely between the states, and threatening people and organizations that are helping women travel out of state for abotion care. Over the last week, I have heard many people say it just can’t possibly be true as they try to visualize a world where you need a negative pregnancy test to board a plane or drive across the state line. But it is true. And it is not a secret. Extreme Texas lawmakers are publicizing their threats to companies, claiming they are subject to felony criminal prosecution for HR policies that reimburse their employees for out-of-state travel for abortion care and have outlined legislation they intend to bring to criminalize. I’m going to do everything I can to protect our reproductive freedom, including the freedom to travel for the care we need. And I am proud to tell you that the House of Representatives has already responded to this effort by passing my bill to protect the right to travel for abortion care last week. It’s so important that people know the real stakes in November’s election, and what is really happening in the ground in Texas. Lizzie’s email earlier this week about her efforts to protect our constitutional right to travel for reproductive health care (and everything else) also highlighted a worrying trend – Republican leaders denying the undeniable facts. This Rolling Stone article lays it out. Check out the article and help us spread the word by sharing it. [] [] The Orwellian future that lawmakers in Texas and elsewhere are proposing is fundamentally contrary to our values as Texans and Americans. But we have a lot of work to do to ensure their vision does not become our future. There is no simple, quick solution. In a state where the legislative districts are gerrymandered, and where statewide elected officials are working every day to make this vision a reality, we need a sustained, systemic, strategic effort to take back our state from extremists who don’t represent the majority of Texans, and don’t care what they think. That’s why we must continue our work, on this campaign and campaigns across the state. We are working now on plans to turn out the vote in TX-07, and to elect the leaders our community and our country deserve. I’m so grateful to know I can count on you to do this with us. Together, we can do anything, [] P.S. As always, I need your help to keep up the fight. A contribution to the campaign so that we can mobilize Texas voters will make a difference today. Friend,
Last week, Senator Elizabeth Warren and Congresswoman Nikema Williams introduced the Youth Voting Rights Act.
**If passed, the Youth Voting Rights Act would greatly expand ballot access for young people and combat efforts to suppress our right to vote.**
The Youth Voting Rights Act would make our elections more accessible by allowing nationwide pre-registration for voters before they turn 18, expanding voter registration and polling places on campuses, guaranteeing student IDs count as voter identification, and much more.
[Tell Congress: Do your part to safeguard the right to vote for young people by passing the Youth Voting Rights Act.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48124428/357011544/741442814?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYTc0ZjE5MS0wODA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4f_ZsVpjZ9rL69SrxBZ6SwPE3rUpI_-3d1IIfwf8fAg=&emci=1517c7f7-8a08-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2a74f191-0809-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172)

| | Hi, this is Ayrillyn, Deputy Finance Director for the Eddie Geller campaign.

Could you take a minute to read this personal note about why it’s so important we elect Eddie Geller?

[Growing up in the Tampa Bay area, I saw how our broken healthcare system hurts all of us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48125031/357013985/1031471839?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220721_FR_AYRILLYNNOTE_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTAwZjVmOS0wOTA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hHe_N6fXZEQbJmXbS4iDOljrIa9ZTXSv5-0FsB7ZcNQ=)

My mom suffered from several severe physical disabilities. When I was just a kid, I started to notice that she was struggling to get the care she needed.

So many doctor appointments led nowhere, long calls to insurance companies ended in tears, and so many spaces were inaccessible to her.

At a young age, I asked my mother why things were so hard for her — and she explained to me that “It’s because of the people that make the rules. The senators and congresspeople and elected officials. [ They just don't understand what people like me need.”](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48125032/357013986/1031471839?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220721_FR_AYRILLYNNOTE_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTAwZjVmOS0wOTA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hHe_N6fXZEQbJmXbS4iDOljrIa9ZTXSv5-0FsB7ZcNQ=)

From then on I knew that I wanted to learn more about politics and uplift candidates who understand that healthcare is a human right and are prepared to stand up for it.

But as I got older, I faced my own healthcare struggles. The only reason I stand here today is because of the great medical professionals who treated me.

[That’s why I’m proud to work for Eddie Geller.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48125033/357013987/1031471839?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220721_FR_AYRILLYNNOTE_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTAwZjVmOS0wOTA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hHe_N6fXZEQbJmXbS4iDOljrIa9ZTXSv5-0FsB7ZcNQ=) He knows that healthcare is a human right and will fight for universal healthcare access when he’s in D.C.

Eddie is the real deal. Every day, I see Eddie live the values he talks about in his campaign. He makes sure that no one is left out or left behind. He listens wholeheartedly and does everything he can to make sure you have what you need.

[I know that Eddie is the best candidate to fight for us in D.C.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48125034/357013988/1031471839?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220721_FR_AYRILLYNNOTE_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTAwZjVmOS0wOTA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hHe_N6fXZEQbJmXbS4iDOljrIa9ZTXSv5-0FsB7ZcNQ=) But right now, Eddie is up against a crowd of MAGA Republicans who promise to make healthcare more inaccessible for people like me.

That’s why this election is so important. Florida’s 15th District is one of the most competitive in the country, and we all need to be working together to win this critical seat.

Eddie works hard every day to deliver for his fellow Floridians, but he can’t do it alone.

clean_body: Growing up in the Tampa Bay area, I saw how our broken healthcare system hurts all of us. | = | | Hi, this is Ayrillyn, Deputy Finance Director for the Eddie Geller campaign. Could you take a minute to read this personal note about why it’s so important we elect Eddie Geller? = My mom suffered from several severe physical disabilities. When I was just a kid, I started to notice that she was struggling to get the care she needed. So many doctor appointments led nowhere, long calls to insurance companies ended in tears, and so many spaces were inaccessible to her. At a young age, I asked my mother why things were so hard for her — and she explained to me that “It’s because of the people that make the rules. The senators and congresspeople and elected officials. = From then on I knew that I wanted to learn more about politics and uplift candidates who understand that healthcare is a human right and are prepared to stand up for it. But as I got older, I faced my own healthcare struggles. The only reason I stand here today is because of the great medical professionals who treated me. = He knows that healthcare is a human right and will fight for universal healthcare access when he’s in D.C. Eddie is the real deal. Every day, I see Eddie live the values he talks about in his campaign. He makes sure that no one is left out or left behind. He listens wholeheartedly and does everything he can to make sure you have what you need. = But right now, Eddie is up against a crowd of MAGA Republicans who promise to make healthcare more inaccessible for people like me. That’s why this election is so important. Florida’s 15th District is one of the most competitive in the country, and we all need to be working together to win this critical seat. name: Ron DeSantis
subject: a truly free state
body:
| | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60846311:J0T0tQVNU:m:1:3317145305:BAFD3E0FE7B6ACCCE05D73AAF3F6520B:r)
---
Peter, Over the past three years, **we have been called to make choices and answer questions we did not expect.**

Questions about how, in a world that seemed frightening and different, we were going to raise our kids, continue to put food on the table, and care for our communities?

And questions that feel further out now like, how does our government interact with its citizenry in a time of crisis?

How is our government -- one of the people, by the people, for the people -- meant to protect life, but not stifle liberty?

_In crisis, do we foster freedom? Or do we force our citizens down?_

Well, over the past three years I believe we have had the truth revealed about those two vastly different approaches. Not in an academic textbook or in a theoretical debate, but in the harsh reality of governing during COVID. You could not find two more starkly different examples than the free state of Florida and the woke tyranny of Gavin Newsom's California.

It isn't hard to understand why the Governor of California wants to talk about Florida. It's part of the one topic he tries to focus on: _**Anything but California.**_

Let's take a look at the record of the "liberal elite" in California:
1. They locked their kids out of public schools at the behest of the teachers' unions.
2. They forced small businesses to close with many never to re-open again.
3. They hobbled law enforcement and allowed drugs and crime to destroy their cities.

Everything on that list is a tragedy, and it's only made worse by the disregard and disrespect shown by leaders like Gavin Newsom. The idea of locking down your citizens and then darting off to the fanciest restaurant in the state to rub their noses in it.

It's wrong, it's disgusting, and it's no surprise that every day driving around Florida I see more and more California license plates as a result.

**In Florida, we didn't bludgeon our people with government mandates; we lifted people up -- protecting their jobs, their businesses, and their kids' education.**
**[Help us keep Florida free in November>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60846311:J0T0tQVNU:m:1:3317145305:BAFD3E0FE7B6ACCCE05D73AAF3F6520B:r "Help us keep Florida free
in November >>>")**
We didn't lock business owners out of their livelihoods and we didn't lock people out of their jobs.

**In Florida we didn't turn a blind eye to crime and drugs, we put criminals behind bars, and we kept our streets safe.**

Gavin Newsom doesn't want to talk about California, and I don't blame him. But the reality is, there are plenty of woke liberal billionaires on Gavin Newsom's speed dial who do not want to see individual freedom succeed. **_They don't want to see it succeed in Florida or anywhere else._**

Because if it succeeds, it shows everyone that the top down nanny-state tyranny of California is avoidable -- Free people making their own decisions are better off than a locked down citizenry dictated to by elitists.

That's why I need your help. Gavin Newsom, funded by Hollywood liberals, Big Tech billionaires, and who knows who else is running ads in Florida. _**I need your help to fight back.**_ **On our side are free people who care to stay that way. On their side is everyone who thinks they know better.**

**Show them that we intend to stay free: [Make a donation right now](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60846311:J0T0tQVNU:m:1:3317145305:BAFD3E0FE7B6ACCCE05D73AAF3F6520B:r "Make a donation right now") to help us fight back. You can use this** **[secure link](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60846311:J0T0tQVNU:m:1:3317145305:BAFD3E0FE7B6ACCCE05D73AAF3F6520B:r "secure link")**.

Sincerely,__

body:
This is a grave moment for American women and for our democracy.
#
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48130907/357026892/-757108457?refcode=dd_em_220721_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYTA0YzUxZi0xMDA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4YwFoTkHXh3nmQ9Sn4HTPzJ9LtWg-l3TayKwn_6g1dA=)
I am the third in a line of four women named Margaret. My grandmother, Margaret Cooke Byers, was born in 1897 and turned 22 on the day that Congress passed the 19th Amendment, which allowed women to vote. My mother, Peggy Byers Wood, saw women achieve the right to control their own bodies, finances, and futures with the Roe decision. I am the third Margaret, becoming the second woman in the history of America to be elected both Governor and Senator.
Over the course of my grandmother's, my mother's, and my lifetime, women have made tremendous progress towards achieving their rights as full and equal citizens in our democracy.
But now, for the first time in our country's history, a generation of American women have fewer rights than their mothers did.
**My daughter, the fourth Margaret in my family, is now less free than I was at her age.**
This is a grave moment for American women and for our democracy. The Supreme Court has taken away the freedom of half the population, freedom that most American women have known for their entire lives.
It seems daunting to contemplate where we go from here. But we have been in similar fights before. We have to keep fighting. We have to organize, mobilize, vote, and do everything in our power to protect our Senate majority – because if Mitch McConnell becomes the Majority Leader, he will ban abortion nationwide.
We owe it to ourselves and the next generation — to women like my daughter, Margaret number four — to keep fighting.
So please, join me in this fight by splitting **[$5 between my campaign and Dick Durbin's to continue the progress we've been working on for hundreds of years.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48130908/357026893/-757108457?refcode=dd_em_220721_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYTA0YzUxZi0xMDA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4YwFoTkHXh3nmQ9Sn4HTPzJ9LtWg-l3TayKwn_6g1dA=)**

My grandmother, Margaret Cooke Byers, was born in 1897 and turned 22 on the day that Congress passed the 19th Amendment, which allowed women to vote. My mother, Peggy Byers Wood, saw women achieve the right to control their own bodies, finances, and futures with the Roe decision. I am the third Margaret, becoming the second woman in the history of America to be elected both Governor and Senator. Over the course of my grandmother's, my mother's, and my lifetime, women have made tremendous progress towards achieving their rights as full and equal citizens in our democracy. But now, for the first time in our country's history, a generation of American women have fewer rights than their mothers did. My daughter, the fourth Margaret in my family, is now less free than I was at her age. This is a grave moment for American women and for our democracy. The Supreme Court has taken away the freedom of half the population, freedom that most American women have known for their entire lives. It seems daunting to contemplate where we go from here. We have to organize, mobilize, vote, and do everything in our power to protect our Senate majority – because if Mitch McConnell becomes the Majority Leader, he will ban abortion nationwide. There are so many challenges that we must address at all levels of government, including in Congress. We must codify the right to reproductive freedom into law, we must help hardworking families who are struggling to keep the lights on, a roof over their heads, and put food on the table, and we must enact federal legislation to ban assault weapons and high-capacity magazines that are wreaking havoc on our communities.

Listen, it’s unfortunate that there are so many elected officials who are career politicians simply using their current office as a stepping stone to the next, only looking out for their own self-interests, not the people they’re supposed to represent — _but it doesn’t have to be that way._

**Part of the solution is to elect leaders like Hava Holzhauer who have done the work in our communities, know firsthand the struggles facing working families, and understand the needs of our seniors. It’s clear we need more Democrats we can trust like Hava Holzhauer in Congress, and she’s counting on your support in the August 23rd Democratic Primary Election — people are already voting by mail!**

Thank you for your time and for sharing your thoughts with us, friend.

— Research Team at Hava Holzhauer for Congress

# Today, Gov. Youngkin officially endorsed my candidacy!
Dear **Peter** ,Gov. Glenn Youngkin, like me, is not a career politician. Last year, he turned the State of Virginia from Blue to Red against all odds. body:
| Friend -- Just a quick note to share that I hope you, and _everyone_ in our country, tunes in **TONIGHT** at 8pm ET / 7pm CT / 6pm MT / 5pm PT for a primetime hearing of the January 6th Committee. We'll be focused on the 187 minutes that began when the President of the United States learned our Capitol was under attack by his supporters and ended with him releasing a video telling the mob he loved them. What was he doing? Who was he talking to? We'll lay it all out tonight. And finally, I'm forwarding along below a Grassroots Update that went out to everyone engaged in our volunteer community. Whether you have the bandwidth to get more involved or not, I always find it encouraging to see ALL the activity going on, and wanted to spread that inspiration today. Back to hearing prep -- see you tonight! Country First, Adam _**< Begin Forwarded Message>**_ **JULY MID-MONTH GRASSROOTS UPDATE** Friend -- State Chapter meetings all across the country; thousands of new members; and a statewide deployment in Michigan to challenge MAGA head-on: These are just a few exciting things happening within the movement! All things Country First have indeed RAMPED up and we would not be here without dedicated volunteers like yourself. The difference we can make together is vitally important to American democracy. We strongly encourage you to read below and decide how you can elevate Country First to new heights. Here’s what you need to know:
* * *
**MICHIGAN MONTH OF ACTION** **Michigan is the primary front in Ultra MAGA's war on democracy, with insurrectionists hoping to take control of the Michigan legislature unless they are stopped by Country First.** The Republican primary elections are drowning in candidates promoting the Big Lie, defending the January 6th insurrection, and using dangerous rhetoric to scare voters into supporting their extreme views. There is no place in this country for political violence or false allegations of voter fraud. This is why Country First volunteers are channeling their energy into calling voters, knocking on doors, and producing written content to prevent Trump-endorsed candidates from moving on to the general election. We believe all reasonable people of goodwill can put partisan affiliations aside in the primary _(for the next 2 weeks!)_ to **[join our Primary First efforts](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=KFozupC4hMau3PknCEub8s9lHalY68t2lmHUMUlbzdVsxbh6fh8NjoFg7eFw7qd6&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_hearing_nd&n=1)**. We have a team deployed here on the ground, have a national network of phone bankers, and digital change-agents ensuring that all Michiganders know to get out and vote. No matter where you live, there are opportunities to make any impact in Michigan's August 2nd primary. Sign up to take action: | [](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=KFozupC4hMau3PknCEub8s9lHalY68t2lmHUMUlbzdVsxbh6fh8NjoFg7eFw7qd6&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_hearing_nd&n=2 "Take Action!") ---
* * *
**STATE CHAPTER MEETINGS + TRAINING**
Each week, state chapters have been launching meetings to recruit more members to volunteer and foster dialogue about the state of our democracy. We strongly encourage all members to join our [Private Troll-Free Facebook Group](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sAbiimTwRd6ssr23ZzK-qLNKlsAAN6GQt_CjSeXswXh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_hearing_nd&n=3) and [Private Slack Community](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=OPXMP9Gjm96HPN5OSJWJsNPRXCR5rxRzKi_1o_IXLuOkk3t81R0kd1Js3u-jmTlEoUCXid3Vy24V6WkmXklZIlmNpkTKENbgOQ7K09Tl8rLyIh8wkVbru8bhQNJaerd7&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_hearing_nd&n=4) to collaborate with other members and stay up to date outside of email notifications and in between meetings. Here are the upcoming meetings:
* **Wednesday - July 20, 2022**
* [Missouri State Chapter - Meet John Wood, Independent U.S. Senate Candidate](https://www.country1st.com/mo072022?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_hearing_nd&n=5)

# **South Bay CRA News**
**Monday July 25th SBRA Meeting**
Don't forget our monthly meeting this coming Monday Night! We have exciting people speaking.
Special Notice:
Starting this Monday we will be meeting back at the El Segundo Public Library. 111 W Mariposa Ave, El Segundo, CA
**Remember our club meets the 4th Monday of every month.**
Blessed and Free
**Nena Gates**
President
nenarenae2@gmail.com
## July 25th SBRA Meeting
---
|

# Denice Gary-Pandol for U.S. Senate 2024
As your United States Senator, I will work to strengthen America's national security and commit to addressing California's crises to fix and save the Golden State.
Having been an analyst on national security issues with expertise in Middle Eastern affairs and International Terrorism, I have worked with Top Secret clearances on U.S. national security concerns and as an Educator for many years. Please see my website: https://denicegarypandol.com/ and my position paper on California's man-made water crisis under ISSUES on my website ... more position papers are on their way...
Here are just some of my positions:
\- Supporting solid and effective national security policies;
\- Ending California's man-made water crisis;
\- Bringing back America's energy independence, a national security issue - it will not only end inflation and high gas prices but grow the job market;
\- Empowering law enforcement to make every neighborhood safe;
\- Ending so-called "social justice reforms" that are soft on crime;
\- Standing for legal immigration while securing the border to end illegal immigration that ultimately deprives Americans of jobs and drives down wages;
\- Delivering on school choice for every child;
\- Delivering on voter integrity;
\- Establishing Opportunity Zones in poor communities that will bring corporate investments and jobs into depressed areas;
\- Standing firm for the founding principles of America while strongly opposing critical race theory, CRT, and more.
As a Constitutional Patriot, I support the America First doctrine. I am committed to taking back our state and our nation for our Judeo-Christian values of freedom and equality, the essence of America's exceptionalism!

body:
Join us in calling on AG Dave Yost to resign
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48135026/357034984/603774595?refcode=em22_220721_Yost2_adv_gq_act___ODP_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220721_Yost2_adv_gq_act___ODP_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjJhNDg4ZS0xNjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1dHkdpWLb4mzEMK-RsTlT0mbpJq8UlDWJks4ZwQGmak=&emci=80ac3839-7108-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=422a488e-1609-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25291327) Team,

The day the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , Dave Yost rushed to court to implement Ohio’s six-week abortion ban, one of the most extreme laws in the entire country. Yet he _still_ doesn’t fully understand how the law functions.

That's not all. Yost went on national television to question the story of a 10-year-old Ohio rape survivor – claiming her tragic story of child pregnancy was all a hoax. **When confronted with the facts, Yost denied any wrongdoing and refused to apologize.**

**[Ohioans deserve better. Add your name to call on Dave Yost to resign as attorney general immediately>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48135028/357034986/603774595?refcode=em22_220721_Yost2_adv_gq_act___ODP_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220721_Yost2_adv_gq_act___ODP_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjJhNDg4ZS0xNjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1dHkdpWLb4mzEMK-RsTlT0mbpJq8UlDWJks4ZwQGmak=&emci=80ac3839-7108-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=422a488e-1609-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25291327)** [CALL ON DAVE YOST TO RESIGN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48135030/357034988/603774595?refcode=em22_220721_Yost2_adv_gq_act___ODP_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220721_Yost2_adv_gq_act___ODP_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjJhNDg4ZS0xNjA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1dHkdpWLb4mzEMK-RsTlT0mbpJq8UlDWJks4ZwQGmak=&emci=80ac3839-7108-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=422a488e-1609-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25291327) As attorney general, Yost should be looking for justice, not getting in the way of it. name: Great America Update
subject: You can learn from Rome’s history
body:
We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6270%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=UJw8%2fhBOm1apXwBaNDjh1A&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64644%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3Mtl9hG6%2bXBQ7HJ1W42dmg&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.” ** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64755%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zFA%2b9yt09k%2fI5kcQuY84tg&sysid=1) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **
---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64756%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wzOSypa03cjisUDdVQ6vFA&sysid=1)
---
| | And, for a limited time, we’ll also send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,” **along with the companion map today: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64757%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kyEdDw%2bwqQ3MUoGxdEqc7g&sysid=1)** Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic” **and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. Before I go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
---

body:
Fellow Conservative:

The fight for the U.S. Senate in 2022 may come down to Missouri, and it's starting to look like everyone knows it. The Democrats, RINOs, and the Washington Establishment are pouring resources into the Show Me State. Now, conservatives must answer, and win.
Conservatives in Missouri and around the country are rallying to support state Attorney General Eric Schmitt (R-MO). He is a proven conservative fighter - one of the most principled and aggressive attorneys general in America.
Please support Eric Schmitt for U.S. Senate today!
Schmitt has demonstrated leadership for years. As a state senator, he wrote the largest tax cut in Missouri's history. As Attorney General he has cracked down on violent crime and led the fights to rescue the Keystone XL pipeline, Missouri's energy and farming sectors, and
working families from Joe Biden's illegal, predatory regulations. And after the Supreme Court's landmark Dobbs decision overturning Roe v. Wade, Schmitt made Missouri the first state in the country to end legalized abortion.
That's why SCF and leading conservatives around the country have endorsed Eric Schmitt. And it's why woke elites are scrambling to defeat him. They know the one thing that can beat The Swamp is principled, fighting conservatives who aren't afraid of them.
Eric Schmitt is not afraid of the woke socialist Left. Please support this campaign and help save our great country!
Polls show Schmitt is in a close primary race against two weaker candidates, including an anti-gun, ex-governor who resigned from office amidst multiple scandals. Democrats know that they can beat him - but not Schmitt.
The elites' campaign against Eric Schmitt is going to be nasty, underhanded, and incredibly well funded. Eric needs to fight every hour between now and the August 2nd primary - and then every day until November 8th.
He will have SCF's help along with an army of conservative leaders, including Ted Cruz, Mike Lee, Dana Loesch, and more.
Now he needs you.
Schmitt needs to show his primary rivals and the GOP establishment that he can answer their attacks blow for blow and dollar for dollar. He has the best ideas and the best campaign - but he needs our support to fuel them to victory.
Please join SCF in helping Eric Schmitt become Missouri's next Senator, and the Senate's next conservative warrior.
SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contribution directly to his campaign.
Thank you for supporting our efforts to build a conservative Senate.

Sincerely,

Matt Hoskins
Senior Advisor

subject: Strong Leadership in the Corner Office
body:
Read about my Campaign for Lt. Governor
| | | |
---
| Hi Everyone, Geoff Diehl and I have been busy on the trail, but I had time to check in with the Lynn Journal, my hometown newspaper.
"I want to see the government work more efficiently for the people that pay into it and the people that it represents," said Allen. "I want to make sure that we're good stewards of people's tax dollars."
She is confident that Massachusetts voters will support a Diehl-Allen ticket in the election. "I think that Beacon Hill needs a balance," said Allen. "Our state legislature is obviously a super majority of Democrats, and they're getting much more progressive. I think to counteract that, we need strong conservative leadership in the corner office."

My plan to bring down prices on prescriptions, gas, child care and more
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48115842/356977624/196037868?sourceid=1071963&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZGY4ZGU5Ny1mYjA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iaiHI2PUoTH4EE6FsHXgkcWtTryul7KAaNdiMX1_OPs=&emci=2819ffcc-f608-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6df8de97-fb08-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=43402276) | Peter, Let’s face it: these days, it’s expensive to be a Vermonter. From the checkout counter to the pharmacy to the gas pump, working families across the state are feeling the pinch. The U.S. Consumer Price Index has risen 9.1 percent over the last twelve months. That, combined with Vermont’s housing, workforce, and child care crises, means Vermont families are struggling. **Here’s how I’ll get to work delivering relief in Congress:** **Prescription Drugs:** I’ll fight to allow Medicare to negotiate with drug companies over prescription drug pricing. Vermonters – especially aging Vermonters – shouldn’t face financial ruin to pay for the medication they need. **Housing:** Vermont needs to build more housing. Through federal investment in wastewater and sewer, we can provide the support needed to boost housing supply in our downtowns. And through The LIFT Act, we can bring homeownership within reach for first-generation homebuyers. **Fuel:** I’ll support an immediate pause on the 18-cent federal gas tax, accompanied by immediate action to accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels. With an eye towards the winter ahead, I’ll further expand investment in LIHEAP to ensure that low-income Vermonters can heat their homes. **Food:** Food prices remain high in the wake of Russia’s unprovoked attack on Ukraine – wartime disruptions and international sanctions have disrupted global food supply chains, and our local farms face skyrocketing costs for everything from fuel to fertilizer to farming equipment. In Congress, I’ll continue our congressional delegation’s leadership on smart agricultural policy, strengthening our local food systems and supporting family farms. **Child care:** Vermont families pay the highest percentage of income on child care in the country. Parents of toddlers are paying one-quarter of every paycheck on child care. That is absurd. To help working parents get ahead, I’ll work to pass a plan to cap the cost of child care at 7% of income. I see it every day on the campaign trail: Vermonters are feeling the strain of high prices. As your Congresswoman, I promise this: I’ll take a pragmatic approach to leadership that puts results over rhetoric, and I’ll remain laser-focused on the most pressing needs of Vermonters. Yours, _Molly_
