body:
| | | Dear Peter, There's only a few hours left to **[use your voice and push for an expansion of Oregon's Clean Fuels Program!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48139228/357051399/1536371503?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRkMjk1ZjlhLTIyMDktZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=v6Ta5IZYFF3Cgajbfcgxq3gz-aSyKoxm9P7HbjWe7g4=&emci=6a2da18a-0d09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=dd295f9a-2209-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** The program has already worked incredibly well to cut tons of pollution from our atmosphere, but it needs to go further to reach Oregon's climate goals and needs. **[Please send the Oregon DEQ an email with your public comment before their deadline at 4:00 PM today!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48139229/357051400/1536371503?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRkMjk1ZjlhLTIyMDktZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=v6Ta5IZYFF3Cgajbfcgxq3gz-aSyKoxm9P7HbjWe7g4=&emci=6a2da18a-0d09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=dd295f9a-2209-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** Thank you, Will Bertellotti, Communications Coordinator, OLCV. — FWD: URGENT: Speak up in support of clean fuels! — Dear Peter, Now is the time to speak up on behalf of our state and planet at large. Oregon’s Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) has opened the stage for public comment in support of expanding the Clean Fuels Program (CFP) in Oregon, and **[_we need you to ask them for a bigger, bolder CFP by the deadline on July 21st at 4:00 PM. _](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48139230/357051401/1409937203?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRkMjk1ZjlhLTIyMDktZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=v6Ta5IZYFF3Cgajbfcgxq3gz-aSyKoxm9P7HbjWe7g4=&emci=6a2da18a-0d09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=dd295f9a-2209-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** The program, which reduces carbon pollution from vehicles, has already been wildly successful, as it has shaved over 6 million tons of pollution from Oregon’s atmosphere for a healthier climate. Expanding the CFP could make it our state’s most important piece of climate action in 2022. DEQ is looking to grow the scope of Oregon’s Clean Fuels Program, but big oil is doing everything they can to ensure that Oregon’s CFP is weakened to undercut its climate benefits and protect corporate profits. This is why we **need** you to fight for the CFP to include: -**An increase in the targets for cutting carbon density, shooting for reductions above and beyond the previous goals of 20% below 2015 emission levels by 2030 and 37% below 2015 emission levels by 2035.** The less carbon in our atmosphere due to clean energy, the better! -**A commitment to achieving a reduction in emissions primarily through the use of electric energy** for a cleaner, healthier climate in Oregon. -**Concrete plans for funding and increasing access to clean energy infrastructure for rural and low income communities and for those living on tribal reservations, as well as Oregon’s BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, people of color) population overall.** Those who are too-often slighted by structural inequality and our governing bodies deserve healthy living environments too! You may be asking– why aren't the already-proposed climate goals of the CFP enough? Between drought, wildfire, and heat waves, Oregon has witnessed harmful climate disasters that will _continue and worsen if we don’t take increasingly drastic climate action and transition to clean energy as soon as possible._ Humanity is at the tipping point for taking action on climate change, so **[_we must urge the DEQ to go bigger in their plans to reduce carbon pollution from Oregon’s cars and trucks, and at a more rapid pace than what has been proposed._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48139231/357051402/1409937203?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRkMjk1ZjlhLTIyMDktZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=v6Ta5IZYFF3Cgajbfcgxq3gz-aSyKoxm9P7HbjWe7g4=&emci=6a2da18a-0d09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=dd295f9a-2209-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** I’m sure you’re tired of high gas prices gouged by out-of-state fossil fuel companies retaliating against climate protections. This is why it is vital that _**[we use our voices to speak up in support of expanding the CFP](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48139232/357051403/1409937203?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRkMjk1ZjlhLTIyMDktZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=v6Ta5IZYFF3Cgajbfcgxq3gz-aSyKoxm9P7HbjWe7g4=&emci=6a2da18a-0d09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=dd295f9a-2209-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** ,_ as it will help guarantee price stability for electric energy homed in-state as opposed to volatility determined by distant oil companies and foreign conflict. Finally, the CFP will create employment opportunities for jobs in clean energy, as well as drive innovation in eco-friendly technology and infrastructure, resulting in a cleaner Oregon climate that cuts pollution and its detrimental health impacts. **[_Will you submit written public comment before 4:00 PM on 7/21/22 to push the DEQ to expand the scope and goals of the Clean Fuels Program and safeguard our state from the wrath of the climate crisis as well as the corporate polluters working to exacerbate it?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48139233/357051404/1409937203?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRkMjk1ZjlhLTIyMDktZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=v6Ta5IZYFF3Cgajbfcgxq3gz-aSyKoxm9P7HbjWe7g4=&emci=6a2da18a-0d09-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=dd295f9a-2209-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** Thank you,
Will Bertellotti, Communications Coordinator, OLCV |

clean_body: | | | Dear Peter, There's only a few hours left to The program has already worked incredibly well to cut tons of pollution from our atmosphere, but it needs to go further to reach Oregon's climate goals and needs. Thank you, Will Bertellotti, Communications Coordinator, OLCV. — FWD: URGENT: Speak up in support of clean fuels! — Dear Peter, Now is the time to speak up on behalf of our state and planet at large. Oregon’s Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) has opened the stage for public comment in support of expanding the Clean Fuels Program (CFP) in Oregon, and The program, which reduces carbon pollution from vehicles, has already been wildly successful, as it has shaved over 6 million tons of pollution from Oregon’s atmosphere for a healthier climate. Expanding the CFP could make it our state’s most important piece of climate action in 2022. DEQ is looking to grow the scope of Oregon’s Clean Fuels Program, but big oil is doing everything they can to ensure that Oregon’s CFP is weakened to undercut its climate benefits and protect corporate profits. This is why we need you to fight for the CFP to include: -An increase in the targets for cutting carbon density, shooting for reductions above and beyond the previous goals of 20% below 2015 emission levels by 2030 and 37% below 2015 emission levels by 2035. The less carbon in our atmosphere due to clean energy, the better! -A commitment to achieving a reduction in emissions primarily through the use of electric energy for a cleaner, healthier climate in Oregon. -Concrete plans for funding and increasing access to clean energy infrastructure for rural and low income communities and for those living on tribal reservations, as well as Oregon’s BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, people of color) population overall. Those who are too-often slighted by structural inequality and our governing bodies deserve healthy living environments too! You may be asking– why aren't the already-proposed climate goals of the CFP enough? Between drought, wildfire, and heat waves, Oregon has witnessed harmful climate disasters that will continue and worsen if we don’t take increasingly drastic climate action and transition to clean energy as soon as possible. Humanity is at the tipping point for taking action on climate change, so I’m sure you’re tired of high gas prices gouged by out-of-state fossil fuel companies retaliating against climate protections. This is why it is vital that , as it will help guarantee price stability for electric energy homed in-state as opposed to volatility determined by distant oil companies and foreign conflict. Finally, the CFP will create employment opportunities for jobs in clean energy, as well as drive innovation in eco-friendly technology and infrastructure, resulting in a cleaner Oregon climate that cuts pollution and its detrimental health impacts. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Zero justification
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We need to cut our bloated defense budget and invest in working people.
#
Peter,
There is ZERO justification for a $60 BILLION increase to an already enormous defense budget when so many of our neighbors are struggling to pay bills and make ends meet.
Yet, that’s what the House did last week: voted for a $60 billion defense budget increase. We do NOT need billions more on top of the massive military spending that already exceeds defense budgets of the following 11 countries combined.
**We need to cut our bloated defense budget and invest in working people.** That means investing in health care for all, public education, childcare, housing, clean energy, climate resiliency, and so much more.
[**Peter, if you’re with me in this fight, please chip in $3 to my campaign. I’m in Congress, and running for re-election, to fight for the people, not a few powerful private defense contractors. We need investments in our people now!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14571?refcode=em20220721-1443&t=1&akid=1443%2E420207%2ESiATTF)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14571?refcode=em20220721-1443&t=20&akid=1443%2E420207%2ESiATTF)**
I’ve consistently voted No on these bloated defense budgets and I’ve consistently advocated for a 10% cut to military spending. If we cut the Pentagon budget, those billions could go towards public health, fighting against climate change, and strengthening the social safety net. **We could invest in the people instead of war and private defense corporations.**
This defense budget would be far higher than any passed under Trump. With so many folks in need of health care, dignified housing, affordable child care, support to pay their gas bills, and more, we need to focus on solutions and investments to help the people. Congress has a duty to the people.

My (true) story starts in Poland during the 1980s when the Soviets ruled the communist bloc.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs8v8fmugcdl5po6msh1dc0nk1plpcvpako3a75o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2udp68orleeq64o3heipr6o3je1g66slhepgnaohi6uoe7chgecq76cpk6lp68dtnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shgcpqm1cr4s1r64phgm2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5c3gm4p74c9i649fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0r07cjs0pjr6heb1fa3g1pi2ef5d6g37nor73jo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5h69p32chh2bs)

Friend,

My (true) story starts in Poland during the 1980s when the Soviets ruled the communist bloc.

Freedom of thought was expressly forbidden, and any attempt could get you thrown into a gulag.

But I had one mission in mind. I needed to do everything in my power to bring the ideas of free markets and liberty to people trapped under communism.

_**So I became a smuggler.**_

Let me introduce myself. I am Lawrence Reed, President Emeritus of the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE).

Recently, I was honored with the **Grand Cross of the Order of Merit of the Republic of Poland.** I don't typically "win" things but this award from a beloved nation not only comes as a surprise but it's also incredibly important to me as a kind of career capstone.

I started my journey smuggling books into Poland, and I continue "smuggling" the ideas of free-market economics and liberty into classrooms across the country through _FEE in the Classroom_.

[_**Friend, can you support a child receiving sound economic education with a donation of $25, $50, $100, or any amount? Click here to send your gift today >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgb7q89mbtdr19gsuemngso3oqntom68haobm710_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5h69p32chh2bs)

It is FEE's mission to inspire, educate, and connect future leaders with the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society, including individual liberty, free-market economics, entrepreneurship, private property, high moral character, and limited government.

Let me explain how that works in **_FEE in the Classroom_.**

_FEE in the Classroom 's_ one-of-a-kind educational workshops uniquely engage, inspire, and equip high school and college students with a deeper understanding of the principles of free enterprise, limited government, and entrepreneurship directly in their brick-and-mortar schools and through their virtual classes.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze1bv4o27qbmpdq2ifg4pscg01vjsa36svs75ubo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5h69p32chh2bs)

Over 87% of these seminars are held in high schools, 65%+ of which are public schools.

In a single day, 75-300 students engage with FEE's faculty of acclaimed instructors through compelling lectures, exciting economic experiments, engaging group discussions, and Q&As on how the core principles of individual liberty and free-market economics apply to their daily lives, communities, careers, and state of the nation.

Our goal is to reach 23,000 students by the end of this year.

[_**Friend**_ _**, can you help FEE "smuggle" the ideas of liberty into high schools across the country. Click here to support al FEE in the Classroom workshop >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl37rkfughfh4udp31rroems66u9lha9dt1jgdc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5h69p32chh2bs)

One of my most treasured possessions is a copy of Milton Friedman's Free to Choose that I arranged to be translated, published, and distributed in Polish in defiance of the communist regime in Warsaw.

And that has driven me forward in my goal of spreading freedom and liberty.

I want ALL our children to be "free to choose" between the ideas of communism and socialism that they're spoonfed in the classroom and the ideas of freedom, liberty, and free-market economics.

And your support matters.

Thanks to our supporters, we were able to pack **75,000 books** and send them to Nevada students.
* 25,000 copies of _I, Pencil_ , a short book about the complexities of making something as simple as a pencil can only be achieved in the free market.
* 25,000 copies of _Are We Rome?_ , a book about the fall of the Roman Empire.
* 25,000 copies of _Myths of the Great Depression_ , which debunks myths on government intervention solving the issue and other economic myths.

Young Americans need to know that there is an alternative. You and I need to get in the classroom and teach the ideals of liberty and economic freedom.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvdcre196s8mmabuaus8v3c1iohrajm7hpasl27g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5h69p32chh2bs)

The next generation is hungry for freedom and liberty. They want their chance at the American Dream.

Friend, will you pass the torch of liberty? Click any button below to donate.

| Dear Fellow Patriot, I write to you today because I know that you are worried about the direction the Left has taken our country. [I CAN TELL YOU THAT IF YOU WANT TO MAKE THE CHANGE WE SO DESPERATELY NEED IN WASHINGTON D.C., YOU SHOULD SUPPORT CANDIDATES LIKE LOREN CULP FOR CONGRESS IN WASHINGTON STATE'S 4TH CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT!](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QZQqtI13uwO7MDFRCXDydIRv-ez7jy0DT4Luo5QEIdC0b2peSdsxWm4gKu0aONWhS-XMYxaZJF7iEa_YBZguuhPpIp9DcyxtqP4Y3vnY__P4FHCI5oD26FenIoEJvOqn6qOtapJdV6Py46FQfXbs3bw5AsVbDdfsyYEkVU1SK9T9dKNwa0gMZQ==&c=KtXnnjCKMLHAZntjOMVUfwVggfRuNyBJ4tLMz3SK6vzpylD52F5GnQ==&ch=h5nnvVjP3oV9JsbuXk4_PihKRa8L5vzXM1fmSUv0uzuhuFqlu5dddg==) Having served for over a decade in law enforcement, as a military veteran, and with over 20 years as a small business owner, Loren Culp understands the importance of selflessness, personal sacrifice, patriotism, and leadership. In addition, he is a man of high character, Christian faith, and integrity and he is my friend. As the Police Chief in Republic, Washington, Loren understood the oath of office that all public servants are bound by. Loren risked his career to stand up for our Second Amendment rights by refusing to enforce a new unconstitutional gun law in Washington State. [See his interview with Tucker Carlson here.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QZQqtI13uwO7MDFRCXDydIRv-ez7jy0DT4Luo5QEIdC0b2peSdsxWm4gKu0aONWhdG8SRCbWu-jM7iDn8yUgvDjuuVhpgF8cqQVyvstVwWTZrglE56oN94m1PeMWW-Phrci-92gBmPrDShmspibX66vX2hZSJ91QIDTkz7JotbI=&c=KtXnnjCKMLHAZntjOMVUfwVggfRuNyBJ4tLMz3SK6vzpylD52F5GnQ==&ch=h5nnvVjP3oV9JsbuXk4_PihKRa8L5vzXM1fmSUv0uzuhuFqlu5dddg==) As you can see, Loren Culp has a backbone and is not afraid to stand up for the American people, even when doing so could negatively impact his own livelihood. I need fighters like him in DC to help me clean up the Swamp. He is running against one of the 10 "RINOs" who voted for red flag laws and to impeach President Trump. [Importantly, Loren has President Trump's endorsement!](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QZQqtI13uwO7MDFRCXDydIRv-ez7jy0DT4Luo5QEIdC0b2peSdsxWm4gKu0aONWhS-XMYxaZJF7iEa_YBZguuhPpIp9DcyxtqP4Y3vnY__P4FHCI5oD26FenIoEJvOqn6qOtapJdV6Py46FQfXbs3bw5AsVbDdfsyYEkVU1SK9T9dKNwa0gMZQ==&c=KtXnnjCKMLHAZntjOMVUfwVggfRuNyBJ4tLMz3SK6vzpylD52F5GnQ==&ch=h5nnvVjP3oV9JsbuXk4_PihKRa8L5vzXM1fmSUv0uzuhuFqlu5dddg==) For far too long, progressive Leftists and RINOs have burdened hard-working Americans like you and me with their failed policies. Now, with one-party rule in Congress and the White House, we've watched gas and grocery prices skyrocket. Inflation is at a 40-year high. Crime is spiraling out of control. This regime's open borders agenda is enriching the cartels and allowing thugs to traffic illicit drugs and humans into America. We need real leadership that will help me put a stop to these disastrous policies! [ALL OF THESE PROBLEMS CAN BE LAID AT THE FEET OF JOE BIDEN, NANCY PELOSI, THE SQUAD, RINO's, AND THE DEMOCRATS!!! SO WHAT CAN YOU DO?](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QZQqtI13uwO7MDFRCXDydIRv-ez7jy0DT4Luo5QEIdC0b2peSdsxWm4gKu0aONWhS-XMYxaZJF7iEa_YBZguuhPpIp9DcyxtqP4Y3vnY__P4FHCI5oD26FenIoEJvOqn6qOtapJdV6Py46FQfXbs3bw5AsVbDdfsyYEkVU1SK9T9dKNwa0gMZQ==&c=KtXnnjCKMLHAZntjOMVUfwVggfRuNyBJ4tLMz3SK6vzpylD52F5GnQ==&ch=h5nnvVjP3oV9JsbuXk4_PihKRa8L5vzXM1fmSUv0uzuhuFqlu5dddg==) The radical Left and establishment RINOs cannot and will not fix America's problems. WE THE PEOPLE need to pay attention to whom we're electing. It is OUR FAULT when we elect and reelect Members of Congress who end up being shills for the establishment. We are awake now more than ever and must take back the House and Senate with real conservatives. Loren Culp will be one of many needed fresh faces who'll restore the Constitution to our broken government. We need Loren Culp for Congress in Washington's 4th Congressional District. Please help him, President Trump and I fight the swamp together! America needs Loren in Congress! Let's ELECT Loren, FIRE Nancy Pelosi, and send a clear message to Joe Biden. body:
Meeting folks on the campaign trail is always a highlight for Peter and the team. Take a look:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=692%2E61531%2EHCiFDC)
Team,
Meeting folks on the campaign trail is always a highlight for Peter and the team. Last Saturday at the Stars and Stripes Festival and Parade in Lyndonville was no different!
It was an amazing day with great energy, huge turnout, and of course some good food and music. It was an honor to participate in this decades-long summer tradition, and Peter is so grateful for everyone who was able to attend and talk with him. Take a look at some of the highlights:
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3500?t=3&akid=692%2E61531%2EHCiFDC)[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3500?t=4&akid=692%2E61531%2EHCiFDC)[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3500?t=5&akid=692%2E61531%2EHCiFDC)[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3500?t=6&akid=692%2E61531%2EHCiFDC)
Peter was able to talk to folks about what’s on the line in this election—a Green New Deal, lower prescription drug prices, affordable housing, and so much more. But his message was simple: we have a real chance to tackle these pressing issues, but only if we come together. He’s been able to make real change as Vermont’s representative in the House, **and if elected Vermont’s next senator, he will continue fighting for a government that works for all, not just the wealthy few.**
The truth is this is an open Senate seat, and we know Mitch McConnell has his sights set on flipping this seat and taking back the majority. That’s why we need All Hands On Deck to deliver a victory this fall. [**Can you chip in $5 or anything you can to help win this race and keep Vermont—and the Senate—blue?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3500?t=7&akid=692%2E61531%2EHCiFDC)
Thanks for being a part of this team!
Welch for Vermont

Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Judicial Watch has filed a federal lawsuit against **New York State** and **New York City** election officials failing to remove potentially _hundreds of thousands of ineligible voters_ from New York City registration rolls!
**Judicial Watch is a national leader in voting integrity and voting rights.**
[That’s why I am asking you help us today with a special contribution! ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59455&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=)
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59455&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=)
---

Federal law requires states to "_conduct a general program that makes a reasonable effort to_ _remove_ " from the official voter rolls "_the names of ineligible voters_ " who have died or changed residence.

But our lawsuit details that New York City's "_own recent data concedes that there were_ _only 22 total removals_ " under this provision "_during a six-year period, in a city of over 5.5 million voters._These are ludicrously small numbers of removals given the sizable__ __populations__ _..._ "

_Dirty voting rolls can mean dirty elections_ , and New York City's rolls are some of the dirtiest in the country. Elections officials in New York City have simply refused to clean the voter lists for years.

We want cleaner elections and we expect this lawsuit will cause New York City to take the simple steps necessary to clean from its voter rolls the names of hundreds of thousands of voters who have moved away or died.

**_You see, where others talk, Judicial Watch acts, and with real impact_!**

**_[And we can do even more if you will join with us and give us your support today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59455&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=)_**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59455&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=)
---

Our highly experienced team of voting rights attorneys cleaned up voter rolls in **California,** **Ohio, Indiana** , and **Kentucky** , among other achievements. We settled a voter roll clean-up lawsuit against **North Carolina** earlier this year after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from the voter rolls.

We also won in **Maryland** , where a court ruled in favor of our challenge to Maryland's Democratic legislature "extreme" congressional redistricting gerrymander.

We are also suing **Illinois** to prevent state election officials from extending Election Day for 14 days beyond the date established by federal law.

[That's why I urge you to make a special gift](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59455&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=) to help our team of talented investigators and attorneys _challenge and stop efforts to corrupt our elections, and enforce federal law requiring_ _states to clean their voter rolls_!

Your support is vital for us to continue to deliver all the legal action, research, investigations and public education that you and other Americans deserve from America's largest and most effective conservative watchdog.

Thank you!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59455&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=)

name: Andrew P. McIndoe
subject: How concerned are you about rising gas prices in America?
body:
Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9416%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=YccgA1r0rC6zfRGkYYdKaA&sysid=1)
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38239%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=X%2bbwla98ScvapqPMOFgiHw&sysid=1)
---
Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38230%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yDDDpSqBQNc0vPh5D0p%2bww&sysid=1) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think--and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38231%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YRpixTE2k8YukgKackrZNQ&sysid=1)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development

clean_body: Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office | | | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think--and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. You can get started right now using this secure link: Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe VP, Development | | The Heritage Foundation 214 Massachusetts Avenue NE Washington D.C. 20002 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

| | Peter, It’s true. I got arrested on Tuesday, participating in a civil disobedience action outside the Supreme Court alongside my colleagues and friends in the Democratic Women’s Caucus. This isn’t the first time I’ve been arrested fighting for human rights. I took my first arrest back in 1987 when I was working with the SEIU — while leafleting and talking to hospital workers on a public sidewalk in southeast Massachusetts, I found myself handcuffed and jailed. In the early 2000s, then AFL-CIO President John Sweeney and I were arrested in Philadelphia alongside graduate employees fighting for their right to organize. In 2005, I was arrested in New York City in another protest with graduate employees fighting to organize at NYU. Later in 2005, I was arrested in D.C. with Rabbi Fred Dobb and others protesting President George W. Bush’s proposal to drill for oil in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. I’ll never forget the guards offering my rabbi a ham sandwich in jail at 3:00 AM. He demurred. I’ll never back down, Peter, when it comes to putting it all on the line for what’s right. I’m willing to do whatever it takes to protect abortion rights and our other civil liberties — even if it means getting arrested. Again yesterday, I joined Senate dining room and cafeteria workers who organized a union with UNITE HERE Local 23 _last fall_ , but have not gotten a first contract. In the U.S. Senate. After almost a year! Many of the workers I met don’t have health insurance. Others have to work multiple jobs to make ends meet. That’s just wrong. Why twice in one week? Because when your allies call on you to join them on the frontlines to demand urgent attention to our most pressing crises, _you_ _show up_. **I’ll never stop fighting for working people. I’ll never stop fighting for my daughter to have the same rights as her mother and grandmothers. I’ll never stop fighting for progress.** [_**This election is less than two weeks away. From: Stacey Abrams
Subject: I need your help to fight against Brian Kemp’s attack on our
reproductive rights.
Date: Wednesday, July 20, 2022

Derek,

Today, Brian Kemp’s extreme and dangerous bill — which makes abortion care
a crime after six weeks of pregnancy, before many women even know they’re
pregnant — was finalized by the courts and is now the law of the land in
Georgia.

This decision bans access to abortion care at 6 weeks and sends a clear
and terrifying message to Georgia women — the freedom to determine if,
when and how to start or grow a family is on the line — and on the ballot.

There is no other way to put it: the person who took an oath to protect us
just made it even more dangerous to be a woman in our state.

Kemp’s callous decision to put politics above women’s healthcare needs
endangers the lives of all women and their families and it will exacerbate
crises in our state.

Under Kemp, Georgia is at or near the bottom on nearly every health care
measure — from doctor and nursing shortages, to maternal and infant
deaths, to the shuttering of three hospitals during the pandemic.

This is outrageous. We deserve better and we must fight back.

As Georgia’s next governor, I will defend a woman’s right to choose,
support reproductive health care with a comprehensive plan for Georgia’s
women in the aftermath of Kemp’s disastrous bill and protect the rights of
all.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1525?refcode=sa_em_220721_B1_Ban_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=1087%2E1862389%2Evm_HLd ]But first, I need your help to win in November so I can take office and
take action. Can I count on you to power our fight with your
first donation
today, Derek?

Derek, as a
legislator, as a woman and as a Georgian, I have spent my career fighting
for reproductive justice. I defeated a bill that would have injected
racial division into medical decisions. I challenged bills that banned
insurance coverage for abortion. I battled those who sought to limit a
woman’s right to control her body – including the six week ban that will
govern the lives of Georgians.

As governor, I will use my office to stop further attacks on women’s
rights in their tracks.

But first, we must stand together — women, advocates, reproductive justice
activists, the LGBTQ+ community, health care providers, allies and all in
our state who will not be still or silent while we are under attack. We
must continue the fight for safe access to the reproductive health care we
need and deserve.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1525?refcode=sa_em_220721_B1_Ban_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=1087%2E1862389%2Evm_HLd ]This will not be easy, but together we can do it,
Derek. Please, if you are able,
will you make a donation to my campaign so that we can stand up for
reproductive rights and pursue reproductive justice?

Derek, in the
days ahead, remember that we are not alone. Believe in our ability to
protect one another. Lean into our capacity to defend our rights in the
streets and at the ballot box.

And know that together, if we unite, we can fight for good.

Stacey

It’s critical that everyone knows how Kemp’s reckless and extreme law will put women’s lives in danger. With a few more grassroots donations today, we can cement our plans to hold Kemp accountable at the ballot box, elect Stacey Abrams and protect reproductive rights in Georgia. But we need your help to get there. [ ]Will you invest $5 or any amount in our campaign to stand up for reproductive rights and pursue reproductive justice? Your $5 contribution will go a long way to protecting women’s health all across the state. [ ]DONATE Thank you, Stacey Abrams HQ - - - - - Begin original message - - - - - From: Stacey Abrams Subject: I need your help to fight against Brian Kemp’s attack on our reproductive rights. Date: Wednesday, July 20, 2022 Derek, Today, Brian Kemp’s extreme and dangerous bill — which makes abortion care a crime after six weeks of pregnancy, before many women even know they’re pregnant — was finalized by the courts and is now the law of the land in Georgia. This decision bans access to abortion care at 6 weeks and sends a clear and terrifying message to Georgia women — the freedom to determine if, when and how to start or grow a family is on the line — and on the ballot. There is no other way to put it: the person who took an oath to protect us just made it even more dangerous to be a woman in our state. Kemp’s callous decision to put politics above women’s healthcare needs endangers the lives of all women and their families and it will exacerbate crises in our state. Under Kemp, Georgia is at or near the bottom on nearly every health care measure — from doctor and nursing shortages, to maternal and infant deaths, to the shuttering of three hospitals during the pandemic. This is outrageous. We deserve better and we must fight back. As Georgia’s next governor, I will defend a woman’s right to choose, support reproductive health care with a comprehensive plan for Georgia’s women in the aftermath of Kemp’s disastrous bill and protect the rights of all. [ ]But first, I need your help to win in November so I can take office and take action. Can I count on you to power our fight with your first donation today, Derek? Derek, as a legislator, as a woman and as a Georgian, I have spent my career fighting for reproductive justice. I defeated a bill that would have injected racial division into medical decisions. I challenged bills that banned insurance coverage for abortion. I battled those who sought to limit a woman’s right to control her body – including the six week ban that will govern the lives of Georgians. As governor, I will use my office to stop further attacks on women’s rights in their tracks. But first, we must stand together — women, advocates, reproductive justice activists, the LGBTQ+ community, health care providers, allies and all in our state who will not be still or silent while we are under attack. We must continue the fight for safe access to the reproductive health care we need and deserve. [ ]This will not be easy, but together we can do it, Derek. Please, if you are able, will you make a donation to my campaign so that we can stand up for reproductive rights and pursue reproductive justice? Derek, in the days ahead, remember that we are not alone. Believe in our ability to protect one another. Lean into our capacity to defend our rights in the streets and at the ballot box. | Peter,
This is unacceptable...
In case you missed it, a Clark County judge recently spewed blatant anti-police rhetoric FROM THE COURT BENCH, showing a clear bias against law enforcement and a complete disregard for having a fair and independent judiciary.
This is seriously what a high-ranking public official who's supposed to be impartial said in a court of law during the middle of a proceeding:
"You don't want to be nowhere where cops are... I don't want to be around where the cops are because I don't know I'm going to walk away alive or not."
This kind of reckless, irresponsible, misinformed attitude towards law enforcement has become too common both in Nevada and across the country.
We shouldn't have to sit back and accept it. I'm calling for this judge to resign \- and I'm also calling on Steve Sisolak to demand her resignation as well. | | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.” ** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a58c2b7fea9547eea045f7bea72471bb&_e=58zx069FhpDbYKBTOoYPO6kvBKcc7VZ7ID_0j3Jb7GKaxRNdzK_glR2zbIIw_MjKn0WmGegBq-BrSwlkk3kG_o0TGznX130h308VQhc3jTequ7YSYVqhIu7t5bjqpaQe_HZQE68XgwiMJN9bPdtAqBiVSOc293JI1b1FQqH5u8bu38w_IQbwKgRgxGVs8FjU1wwl2JcyJjBQl5raoY_hUGEDCKJLk3c9DdQooIQF3L_A90L9Ue0qXF8GpFiIdhXJEvPytKzp2FDvCG3kAv_toIt-EVoz6vZNWNZrbPNRPLpH6pRX6ub1d9B3tf9ORAieD3KAs9z33flz70_f5OZ4-c4eGTjyUyRZB-KNXcFhDiCpgetL_FOyxp1JWX3-PJuinGlS-yIoZuoDQnvqCmWRvb1dEo7wdiELdUmd-kySbar_p0UYiZ2XpJT1cBtffuItJyd-jd8V4o8gjGy-VTH0_g%3D%3D) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **

First, it’s important to know that **this decision _does not_ impact the November 2022 election.**

subject: You're the reason I got in this race.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ben Smilowitz for Congress
body:
Thank you for standing with me. | | | |
---
|
---
| | | Dear **Peter,**

It's clear the primary results are not close to what we were hoping for.

I'm grateful for all of the generous time, effort, and resources that so many people contributed to our campaign. Earning your support has meant so much and I'm sorry and disappointed that we didn't do better.

I'm grateful for my family's support and patience. Holly worked extra hard to keep our kids' lives as normal as possible and support me through it all, on top of working her regular full-time job as a psychologist. I couldn't have competed without that and my kids' understanding.

My kids have been incredible campaign partners in this effort. Not yet ten years old and they each communicated with thousands of voters and learned so much. What could have been incredibly disruptive and distancing was instead a bonding experience. They may be a little jaded (especially about the harsh reality of money in politics) but I'm grateful they had a positive experience and were able to meet so many wonderful people (on both sides of the aisle) across these five counties. After polls closed Tuesday, my 9-year-old told me that this was the best experience of his life.
I truly enjoyed having conversations with thousands of voters, all across the District. So many people remarked that it was the first time a candidate knocked on their door or personally called. Some didn't believe it was actually me calling and thought I was a recording! I'm grateful to those that took the time to share their personal challenges and hopes for improving our communities, state, and country.

We all know politics can be a dirty sport and this experience has been very enlightening. I've been inspired by some of the candidates I met on the campaign trail. I'm grateful for their support and encouragement and I'm ready to roll up my sleeves to help them win. That said, we need better candidates to run for many positions. If we don't try, we'll never win.

I knew this wasn't going to be an easy race. Our campaign stood for ideals that we'll continue to advance - hopefully together. I will continue to advocate for people, as I have for the last 25 years.

I will also remain engaged in our region. As a long-time advocate, I didn’t need an elected office to influence policy and hold our leaders accountable. I look forward to working with you to improve MD-6, our state, and country.

Given the primary results, I'm not sure there's one specific thing that, had we done differently, would have resulted in a much more favorable outcome.

That said, I'll make a few points:
* Money in politics. Nearly everyone says they dislike it but few vote against it.

* In April, nearly three months of our campaign's efforts were lost when a judge decided to strike December's district map. April's new map removed thousands of voters that I’d spent months knocking on doors and calling. Drawing more fair and representative districts is important. Redrawing the lines just a few months before a primary is like moving the bases in the 5th inning. Grassroots campaigns across the state, arguably better for our Democracy and representative government, were hit hard.

* Local media is essential. Local papers are struggling everywhere and there are major gaps in local reporting across MD-6. This deficit allows power to go unchecked and it prevents people from being informed. Just days before the primary, some voters were still confused about which Congressional district they were in. We spent much of the last few months educating voters previously in the 8th about their move to the 6th.

* Fake news: Many voters don't know what to believe. Some didn't believe the factual information about my opponent's donations to Abbott, Paxton, and others. Others, including a state delegate I met on Tuesday, didn't believe that my opponent was still leading his multi-billion dollar business while serving in Congress.

* Youth civic engagement is essential. We complain our Democracy is at risk-- and it is. But our young people can save it if they are respected, supported, and engaged. Bring your kids to vote. Encourage them to get involved and volunteer to advance an issue they're passionate about or a candidate they like. Let them listen to NPR and read the newspaper. The only way we'll ever confront and challenge the harsh realities of the world is if we're informed and engaged.

* I've said this all along, and I'll say it again: There are significant national implications for keeping this seat Blue and we should do what we can to prevent Neil Parrott from representing MD-6.

I value our relationship and won't share your email address with others. Please stay in touch with me. There's more work to do.
Best ways to reach me:
ben@bensmilowitz.com
phone/SMS: 301-578-5888
Thank you again. Ben

PS: If you have a yard sign, please don’t throw it away. I’d like to keep as many as I can.

As a long-time advocate, I didn’t need an elected office to influence policy and hold our leaders accountable. I look forward to working with you to improve MD-6, our state, and country. Given the primary results, I'm not sure there's one specific thing that, had we done differently, would have resulted in a much more favorable outcome. That said, I'll make a few points: Money in politics. Nearly everyone says they dislike it but few vote against it. In April, nearly three months of our campaign's efforts were lost when a judge decided to strike December's district map. April's new map removed thousands of voters that I’d spent months knocking on doors and calling. Drawing more fair and representative districts is important. Redrawing the lines just a few months before a primary is like moving the bases in the 5th inning. Grassroots campaigns across the state, arguably better for our Democracy and representative government, were hit hard. Local media is essential. Local papers are struggling everywhere and there are major gaps in local reporting across MD-6. This deficit allows power to go unchecked and it prevents people from being informed. Just days before the primary, some voters were still confused about which Congressional district they were in. We spent much of the last few months educating voters previously in the 8th about their move to the 6th. Fake news: Many voters don't know what to believe. Some didn't believe the factual information about my opponent's donations to Abbott, Paxton, and others. Others, including a state delegate I met on Tuesday, didn't believe that my opponent was still leading his multi-billion dollar business while serving in Congress. Youth civic engagement is essential. We complain our Democracy is at risk-- and it is. But our young people can save it if they are respected, supported, and engaged. Bring your kids to vote. Encourage them to get involved and volunteer to advance an issue they're passionate about or a candidate they like. Let them listen to NPR and read the newspaper. The only way we'll ever confront and challenge the harsh realities of the world is if we're informed and engaged. I've said this all along, and I'll say it again: There are significant national implications for keeping this seat Blue and we should do what we can to prevent Neil Parrott from representing MD-6. I value our relationship and won't share your email address with others. Please stay in touch with me. There's more work to do. Best ways to reach me: ben@bensmilowitz.com phone/SMS: 301-578-5888 Thank you again. Ben PS: If you have a yard sign, please don’t throw it away. I’d like to keep as many as I can. | | | | Paid for by Ben Smilowitz for Congress | Our mailing address is: Ben Smilowitz for CongressPO Box 275Gaithersburg, MD 20884-0275 Want to change how you receive these emails? You can or .

name: Brandon Tatum
subject: Most hateful organization in America
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsts1rhoraej0349kpjnnaecnq11di6a4js0tvig_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf5c3jepj3bdhkclo62dhk62pbbc34ckr36dj7mirm0p3k69hr6p9h65rrbc35e3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coored9ic1pbephkssqr4ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdim1ob6cth62ob24no)
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zil9qmq6c8sch2s8aucueu8pu6akifjutqpkknn8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztd2r7gmf9od5n7pn7n1kthbs9mdbsr05nt1f0jg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr6htgh8ij3orcl7gvgse1rdb1049de3152l004g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm5auu1mnhhod6mlv7a2c6at2502n39j5u8nbbc0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zlm0n903o8b972fsia8f17a5ovdlkkh1hd7d30bg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuci192t1kocaqtj8bko0gpihl6rds3rdjrl66bo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zq1jcustejje781mvgtn4f9vq9cji78qj1aq8gd0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zumqe1v57nd3hgqrfgrh9fgctilr4nltgh574ev0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z07jbh5qltl1bnf4m50g6cjba6ubte5fgpk24hno_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zknqaf16mlsqffopg8dqprmd3hu92mm7n7sere70_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zj3hi3u5rk9i1c7sdmt2rps331ha1hoiu77tdi28_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsp537m30naapsa6cilaiok4d69tqlc9svf4aclg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z3b6qpebqipbekqtjd0ccu60pe118b3ec1538hj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztiqemhf9nunsu39ab8mqfbt6bb021ivmgki8h68_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgs52os2362u92t1ncgnt5u942r48rqrmnsbprn0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8i1i25q8lscqio7uo54rrbuv3u0qml443gj62mo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkmesctcsbkdk8j561sf55qqfghnfstb24duldq8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfsi4e38sh0eqbh878adih64nmuv3kkmleovumko_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zh6sarl3lmcuth5qbe7do3iriiashth5v5hbftpg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zetkik1d2d6u9bqmvdrr8jqvq6vsvs71o7jgaq0o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfue72krq2b2latg2iusbeutcevl8khuphnniln0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j6eoj1c5h2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

Friend – it wasn’t surprising to see this headline in _The New York Times_ : | **“Next Front Line in the Abortion Wars: State Supreme Courts”**
---
Now that the U.S. Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , state supreme courts are one of the last lines of defense against abortion bans – IF we can keep them out of GOP hands.

And right now that’s a big if. Thirty-two states will be electing judges to their highest courts this year, and Republicans have announced they’re making these races a priority.

[**Will you help the NDRC keep the GOP from dismantling our democracy?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48145664/357079777/1479146301?amount=20&refcode=20220722.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZkMmRmNjE1LTM4MDktZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AlVus8oQ21ENSxLci5aQKSueZEuvNjZXebD-76PSrPk=)
Abortion isn’t all that’s at stake at the state court level. State courts have been a critical line of defense against Republican attempts to gerrymander and restrict the freedom to vote. In fact, that’s exactly why Republicans are so interested in replacing fair-minded judges with partisans who they believe will let them manipulate maps.

You don’t have to take it from me. A spokesperson for the Republican State Leadership Committee said that “**If Republicans and conservatives want to control the redistricting process... [they] also need to control the supreme courts.** ”

But we have a plan. This election year, we’re targeting _three_ key state supreme court races – in Ohio, Michigan, and North Carolina – as part of our Democracy Targets campaign. We’re committed to protecting these courts as neutral arbiters that will defend voters against gerrymandering, voter suppression, and the curtailing of reproductive rights.

I’ll be blunt, friend: We need your financial support to execute all the parts of our plan. That’s why I’m emailing you today. **Will you chip in whatever you can to help the NDRC defend our rights and democracy?**

subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zaf9cunb7ve1jh3frbte9n4gom4071go5dig2nu8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j61pb4cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq9dhkumqb7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65s3ksljjccj4s3ib4pjmmjij9o9mempr8s31c8qr6dljcarjcthnc3i36otkm1jrfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p30pjlcapm8o3i65j35c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
| | | This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkb1i5f1e705l77sv5gus0sq7lkvucvtjq4o7058_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j61pb4cjh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdd1k2regif9vkmk5ug8ugn83pum2c3efca06h5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j61pb4cjh2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zt4orc8vaksukpm3gdms3eat9e1qeac5lqq5sbmg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j61pb4cjh2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Peter, if you turn on the news, there's a good chance you'll hear my name.
Typically, it's alongside a dishonest legacy media headline misrepresenting my agenda, insulting the people of Florida, or implying FREEDOM is the latest and greatest threat to America.
It is an insulting and absurd way to distort the truth and mislead you, the American public.
Their attempts at intimidation won't work on me though. I am not backing down. Not even a little bit.
I welcome the "insults" and the hard work to refute them because I know the importance of strong leadership in a time like this. That is why I'm running for re-election, and I hope you'll [**pledge your support for my campaign.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=3aec11a0ada9454ba225af8de975f391&_e=UOgnLCJyBKPfbTVSGKEQ2utvYpjkcZNrwryVAGIWSie3iL8rf4SCpXJg6y5IbsWoiMwNnzZ5vE0reKVz29ToqKZHyR7oBaTq8axjsTGtQzCepzjRHCXyrh-yp8pIDBd1pFBdr6Q1I-IvQmkdE1mPH-aogEWBMAGcd9pA3bhaPZTuIg62kh-ENzJv-SfKRP1Xk0BbOfB4skLqHdTbfglBoE7whedssa1CfDygk1qsIw1RaqLFplwUOeLy0g9Ugh-ti1OTVyZ5oWXKTjfkeny4wAKrvCKSaZEwXI_164zwyCStPNmUwI0EPm8S8LcrsBgZpe8oQqEJGztN-dMx5npicbsqYFub1CYQmt-kuli-N3XnEYBeY1tNRX-eB5DRdSksxhIn17ltzfu_NfvMdeeyrQ%3D%3D)
If you're still hesitant about getting involved, I'd like to remind you what we're up against. It is evident how far to the left the media has gone by looking at how they define "radical."
* Allowing grown men and women to assess personal risk and decide to wear a mask or not: **RADICAL.**
* Allowing CHILDREN under 9 years old to make life-altering, sometimes irreversible, decisions about their "gender identity": _**JUST FINE!**_
* Encouraging an educational environment focused on learning and preparing students for the real world: **RADICAL.**
* Encouraging students to hate themselves, their peers, and our country: _**JUST FINE!**_

The stakes could not be higher.
These out-of-touch liberal elites are so threatened by rational thought that they will call me radical for standing with everyday people on the side of common sense and sanity. If that makes me a radical, so be it.
I will always defend our liberty, protect our children, and promote the ideals of our Constitution which make our country the greatest on earth. No amount of intimidation or petty name-calling is going to change that.
[**> > SUPPORT RON DESANTIS NOW >>**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=3aec11a0ada9454ba225af8de975f391&_e=UOgnLCJyBKPfbTVSGKEQ2utvYpjkcZNrwryVAGIWSie3iL8rf4SCpXJg6y5IbsWoiMwNnzZ5vE0reKVz29ToqKZHyR7oBaTq8axjsTGtQzCepzjRHCXyrh-yp8pIDBd1pFBdr6Q1I-IvQmkdE1mPH-aogEWBMAGcd9pA3bhaPZTAv2EkvacG0YDAjP_2yhPh3EzgI1cx25G-poZnQnlvJizV9ISMAm0rZr0e8hbSpH0DwLce04Jx92qxxtCFUCSUytrtfDhCKo08ZsAUXyF_s2ej8kOYB4WNwUTCM0azfPZyDAcTbVLSjb4QqFHo4mmE4z4h7KICmLZ0CfJa2TEiQUjtbbmECLI1pdPVoMrvGtfZVpT18qq3IJ7WNL_3X8ArY1SuCyZvmPG4Sepxi7MXMA%3D%3D)
From my time in the Navy to my time in Congress, I have always been committed to preserving our freedom and building a better future for our children.
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=3aec11a0ada9454ba225af8de975f391&_e=UOgnLCJyBKPfbTVSGKEQ2utvYpjkcZNrwryVAGIWSie3iL8rf4SCpXJg6y5IbsWoiMwNnzZ5vE0reKVz29ToqKZHyR7oBaTq8axjsTGtQzCepzjRHCXyrh-yp8pIDBd1pFBdr6Q1I-IvQmkdE1mPH-aogEWBMAGcd9pA3bhaPZRl2rHbn01Tt1yPwFqQgKwyipfUOIqDT1J-bHlnUDFjHznWtYzApVVvpvmequnXJf-QM9ExfNYS_jDM2OaGPdD6xij8yr47tJagPZltzb3KOiF8XG9pK27w4ivJtcQ3eaCdKvx_40lSURFbyrp4gratR3aqQA39uRhyyvnK_hPsMUlkZKwldsJGDSNRhlYuVPy_1QoIUHYKJlRX0U_jakj_rd0RlK9t_D4lyh5SjOS02g%3D%3D)
I have three children, and I worry every day about the consequences that progressive policies could have on their lives.
We have open borders inviting millions of illegal aliens, potential criminals, and thousands of pounds of illegal drugs into our country. At the same time, liberals try to defund our police forces and appoint judges who are soft on crime.
We're experiencing record-high inflation which threatens families with higher costs at the pump and the grocery store, all while the Biden administration spends your tax dollars into oblivion.
We have kids - who are just trying to get an education - being injected by the anti-American agenda of woke corporations, woke politicians, and fraudulent media elites who have lost their grip on reality.
I will never let these out-of-touch fanatical liberals win. [**JOIN RON DESANTIS NOW!**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=3aec11a0ada9454ba225af8de975f391&_e=UOgnLCJyBKPfbTVSGKEQ2utvYpjkcZNrwryVAGIWSie3iL8rf4SCpXJg6y5IbsWoiMwNnzZ5vE0reKVz29ToqKZHyR7oBaTq8axjsTGtQzCepzjRHCXyrh-yp8pIDBd1pFBdr6Q1I-IvQmkdE1mPH-aogEWBMAGcd9pA3bhaPZQHZCUfpK0ijPScH9-b6xgujl21kWUfH4myemRzYB7KA6CFBU9a0bWFpfn283TEFeHcTayMxSJipTsI6mv5BjjwSuDs2X_FMds5pAbVgwAuZfyfdeg6wrDtwjGrqd4Ku2iMB-TMqXKdK-nHVfmqsS6oVeUWxD3L7NsRV2az2G2hqQ5bBNk8H7V-yCZPkJMXF68jPY7ZndEx7B4Mqkl457nDR9RTweOVt5eC4UPZ-PBs3w%3D%3D)
As a federal prosecutor, I dedicated my time to convicting child predators and removing dangerous criminals from our Florida streets. I continued my mission in Congress by authoring bills that ended the secret taxpayer-billed slush funds members of Congress were using to pay off those who accused them of sexual harassment.
Our law enforcement, prosecutors, judges, and elected officials should work to protect us - not to protect criminals. Now, as Governor, I am standing by our law enforcement officers and holding the Soros-funded, soft-on-crime prosecutors accountable to keep our communities and our families safe.
I took immediate action to end the COVID theater which crippled our nation and focused on empowering small businesses with common-sense tax policies which made it easy to hire American and fuel our Florida economy. _**Florida is in a better place now than it was before the pandemic - and that 's not something liberal governors can say today.**_
I'm also leading the fight for parents and students against the poisonous, WOKE elitists to ensure our education system is NOT an indoctrination camp.
It's simple: **we 're not going to tell kindergarteners they are racist or they are oppressed.** And we're not going to force-feed our children progressive ideologies that are confusing and wildly inappropriate for their age.
We will prepare the next generation **for greatness** by teaching real history instead of perverting our past to serve the ideological goals of far-left activists who would like our children to hate America and each other. Every student should feel empowered to succeed - and together, we can make sure that they do.
If all this is "RADICAL," then Peter, I think you and I have something in common: we're both **RADICAL.** I could use your help continuing what we started here in Florida. Will you chip in now to become an official supporter of my campaign?

| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt815psj24ndho2p0aeufqq987bde60gg122jp9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s5j69pj5c3h2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**

---
| | Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.

subject: It’s time to level the playing field and rebuild the middle class
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mike Van Someren for WI
body:
Mike has a plan | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/0338604b7baf/i-am-running-for-congress-9137578?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=1fe0bea802&e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | Hi there,

**The middle class in America has been on the decline for over 40 years thanks to economic policies that have enriched the super-wealthy and megacorporations**.

While the super-wealthy expanded their share of the pie through special-interest sweetheart deals, the middle class has become hollowed out. [**Now, it’s time to level the playing field and rebuild the middle class.**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=d94d7ca4e4&e=356c0699dd)

I’ve said time and again throughout this campaign that we need to help the folks putting in an honest days’ work get ahead, while helping those in need get back on their feet again.

[**This is how we do it.**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=4f2e0e28b5&e=356c0699dd)
---
| [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=dc8bb2cc0f&e=356c0699dd)
---
| [Read Mike's Full Plan](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=7484584f26&e=356c0699dd "Read Mike's Full Plan")
---
| We have a market economy with a number of broken markets. These broken markets have created an economy with higher prices, fewer jobs with family-supporting wages, fewer jobs overall, a distorted media, and tenuous supply chains in a variety of sectors from food to manufactured goods.

Fixing these markets through the policies outlined above will go a long way to actually solving the problems facing everyday Americans and will not just transfer some wealth from the very wealthy to the working poor.

**They will allow Americans to work and get ahead from that work. Better yet, they will put America back on a path to being on the cutting edge of new technologies, products, and living standards.**

The American middle class was the economic engine of the world at one time and it needs to be rebuilt and strengthened. We must ensure that Americans at the bottom of the socioeconomic ladder can get into the middle class, and those in the middle class are secure in that status with little risk of falling out.

Once elected, I’ll do everything in my power to make sure we level the playing field and truly rebuild the middle class.

[Join us for a live discussion on Facebook of these policies July 28, 2022 at 7:30 pm.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=de8637bdee&e=356c0699dd) This is your opportunity to ask questions and share thoughts on the economic future of our country. [You can also ask us questions ahead of time through this link](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=397ad05c9a&e=356c0699dd).

Thank you,
Mike

I’m running for Congress because I’m prepared to take on these tough fights and defend the rights of all Vermonters.= = I’ve worked to ensure LGBTQ+ youth are safe and protected here in Vermont by voting to ban “conversion therapy” and advocating for the gender-inclusive bathroom bill on the Senate floor – but there’s still work to be done on the federal level to protect LGBTQ+ Americans. We should all be alarmed that 77% of Republicans voted against marriage equality – something that over 70% of Americans support. At this moment, we must send tested and proven legislators to Congress who will do whatever it takes – including abolishing the filibuster – to defend our freedoms here in Vermont. That’s exactly what I’m prepared to do. Let’s get it done, Vermont.= Yours, Becca Balint Becca believes the best thoughts are not always from the loudest voices in the room. As President Pro Tem of the Vermont State Senate, she's led the charge to invest in affordable housing, fight climate change, enshrine reproductive freedom into our state's constitution, and so much more. Now, she's running for Congress to have a greater impact on more Vermonters. To comply with Federal law, we must use our best efforts to obtain, maintain and submit the name, mailing address, occupation and name of employer of individuals whose contributions exceed $200 per election cycle. Thank you in advance for including that information along with your check. Paid for by Becca Balint for Vermont, P.O. Box 291, Burlington, VT, 05402 `
