name: Sam Ricketts, Evergreen Action
subject: Here's our game plan
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
The climate crisis remains. So does our resolve.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4338?t=2&akid=13070%2E53494%2EWCrkg9) Friend, Last week, Senator Joe Manchin abruptly shut down historic climate investments. He betrayed the American public and the Democratic Senate's mandate to act on climate. **It's time for President Biden to take the gloves off.** The climate crisis is not waiting on Joe Manchin. **And neither are we.** [_**Read our latest memo to learn about the five immediate steps President Biden can take on climate without Congress. We're ready to continue the fight for a clean energy future—and we need you with us.**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4338?t=3&akid=13070%2E53494%2EWCrkg9) | [READ MORE](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4338?t=4&akid=13070%2E53494%2EWCrkg9)
---
The climate crisis is only getting worse—just look at the historic heatwaves, wildfires, and droughts across the U.S. and Europe. And without substantive U.S. climate leadership, the world will miss our climate goals and continue down this needlessly destructive path.
So, here's an inside look at how we're pushing forward in the fight for a clean energy future:
1. Our **100% Clean Power** campaign is mobilizing support for policies from the EPA, the Department of Energy, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commision, and other agencies that will rapidly accelerate the transition to 100% clean electricity.

2. Our **Freedom from Fossil Fuels** campaign is fighting to end fossil fuel corporations' abuse of public resources, end oil and gas drilling on public lands and waters, and support a just transition for impacted communities.

3. States must once again lead on climate. We're investing in key battlegrounds to strategically support state-based climate action.

4. We will continue to push the Biden administration to use the full extent of their executive authority on climate action—and deliver the whole-of-government approach that helped him get elected.

President Biden has pledged to cut climate pollution by 50% by 2030, reach 100% clean electricity by 2035, and ensure prioritized federal investment in disadvantaged communities through his Justice40 Initiative. Without Congress' support, the president must work harder than ever to meet those goals.
[_**Read about the five things Biden can do right now—and get ready to fight harder than ever for the future we need and deserve.**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4338?t=5&akid=13070%2E53494%2EWCrkg9)
[READ MORE](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4338?t=6&akid=13070%2E53494%2EWCrkg9)
---
Onward,
Sam Ricketts
Co-Founder, Evergreen Action

clean_body: Peter, this is the race to watch | | | Hi Peter – The first campaign I had the privilege of working on was Tim Ryan's campaign for President. I had seen first-hand how he worked for rural Ohio and rural America as a whole, and I pledged my full support for him. Over a year ago, United Rural Democrats and I called on Tim Ryan to run for Senate. We said that we needed someone who has fought tirelessly for Northeastern Ohio to continue supporting working rural and urban Ohioans in the Senate. Since then, Tim Ryan announced his campaign for Senate, and he has continued to underscore the importance of cutting rural workers into the deal. But since the day that we announced our support for Tim Ryan, he's faced an uphill battle against the GOP. Trump's influence remains extremely strong in Ohio, and the GOP has a super-majority in the Legislature. The Republicans are using this to their advantage, proposing new voter restrictions to benefit their candidates, and Tim's opponents are out-crazying each other to win the nomination. We know what's at stake here: our Senate majority. And we know what a difference another vote for the Democratic column would have on passing meaningful legislation for workers and rural America. The truth is, there's no one who knows Ohioans' issues and has the ability to solve them better than Tim Ryan. His campaign has emphasized creating new opportunities for rural Ohio. body:
Our communities deserve to be safe.

| Peter,

As a member of the United States military and intelligence services, I’ve been trained to use firearms. I’ve also seen up close the violence and destruction guns can cause in the deadliest hardship and combat zones.

**Yet too many American communities have seen that same carnage here in the homeland.**

Children are slaughtered in schools. Shoppers are attacked in grocery stores. Just this month, on the 4th of July, a horrific mass shooting took seven innocent lives at a parade in Highland Park, Illinois.

Peter, I was deeply disappointed when, last week, WI-03’s congressman was the sole Democratic vote _against_ critical, commonsense legislation that would help alert communities to gun violence threats. 43 Republicans bucked their leadership to vote with the majority for this legislation that will save lives. His vote was out of step with what the majority of voters in our district and across the country are asking for right now.

During my work in combat zones and hostile environments, the idea of creating a safer world for my kids and grandkids sustained me. I think of them, and of every American, now.

**If elected to Congress, I will be a strong voice in support of reasonable measures to keep our communities safe, including banning ghost guns and requiring checks for violent history. If I were serving now, I would have voted in favor of the gun violence alert legislation. As it is, I am the only candidate in my race who’s spoken up about this issue.

clean_body: Our communities deserve to be safe. | Peter, As a member of the United States military and intelligence services, I’ve been trained to use firearms. I’ve also seen up close the violence and destruction guns can cause in the deadliest hardship and combat zones. Yet too many American communities have seen that same carnage here in the homeland. Children are slaughtered in schools. Shoppers are attacked in grocery stores. Just this month, on the 4th of July, a horrific mass shooting took seven innocent lives at a parade in Highland Park, Illinois. Peter, I was deeply disappointed when, last week, WI-03’s congressman was the sole Democratic vote against critical, commonsense legislation that would help alert communities to gun violence threats. 43 Republicans bucked their leadership to vote with the majority for this legislation that will save lives. His vote was out of step with what the majority of voters in our district and across the country are asking for right now. During my work in combat zones and hostile environments, the idea of creating a safer world for my kids and grandkids sustained me. I think of them, and of every American, now. If elected to Congress, I will be a strong voice in support of reasonable measures to keep our communities safe, including banning ghost guns and requiring checks for violent history. If I were serving now, I would have voted in favor of the gun violence alert legislation. name: Tiffany Shedd for Attorney General
subject: It started with incorrect voter ID cards…
body:
How Pinal County disenfranchised thousands of rural voters
---
| | | | | | | |
---

| | | | | | |
---
| | |
---|---|---
|
## July 21, 2022
|
| | |
---|---|---
| Several weeks ago, my family and I received our new Pinal County-issued voter ID cards. Before ballots were even mailed, I noticed they had listed our address in Casa Grande instead of Eloy. I knew then that this mistake was going to affect more voters than just me. I immediately brought this to the attention of Pinal County election officials. Instead of correcting the mistake, however, we were told to not contact election officials by the deputy county attorney. Incorrect voter ID cards were a warning but only just the beginning of Pinal County’s broken voting rolls. When my son received a ballot that included a Casa Grande city council race, I was in shock. But then I learned that this very thing was happening to thousands of voters in Apache Junction, Casa Grande, Eloy, Mammoth, Maricopa, Queen Creek, and Superior. Pinal County admitted that it sent _65,000 voters_ incomplete ballots and an _unknown number_ of ballots to voters listing municipal races they are not eligible for. When my husband and I voted in person I also received an incorrect ballot that had Casa Grande City Council Races on it. To date the address on my voter ID card and voter registration has not been corrected. The Pinal County spokesman blamed the issue on human errors. But I’m left wondering if they took my complaint seriously weeks ago, would this issue have been avoided? Their arrogance told me all I needed to know— _this was going to be an absolute disaster._
Pinal County ignored our complaints. They need to be held accountable. This grave mistake is incompetence at best, voter disenfranchisement at its worst.My open message to Pinal County—and every county—elections don’t belong to the government, they belong to the people. This is not a Democrat or Republican issue, this hurts everyone. It is an incomprehensibly huge disaster to both receive a ballot for an election that you are not qualified to vote in and be denied your lawful right to vote in your own city’s elections. I still remember being called crazy for having legitimate concerns about the security of our elections. But now it’s happening, _again_. _So, I’m sounding the alarm._ We can’t afford to sit by and let indignant election officials dismiss our concerns out of hand and damage what is left of our confidence in our elections. After being told to stop my inquiries by Pinal County, I filed an online complaint with the Attorney General’s Office and the Election Integrity Unit. Without civil subpoena power, I’m concerned that they will have little recourse to investigate this mess. **That’s where you come in.** If you’re an Arizona voter and have election issues, **drop us a tip and we’ll amplify your voice.** I’m setting up a website, “[**Tiffany’s Tipline**](https://88783.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/fiZ8Wx9C-tdxeBJouiDHiDEf9APJRlnmy-Z7m0PNlajO7fdT7lyAgCH_vzxQf8Wt3mlny19RM9t1y8v7AQsFBzWqrY2DsfJmaIVBU6mzH2oYP9Kb9oY2R7Qpg1hsbNAsGra8Cymn0SsFMESEb11hvJFro48nzUoDjMNSbxq9tNNsHgLTMwdxKLXx47_F6A93ZrWq4WFXTWroBUVz8MN0vdg)”, so I can compile a list of concrete examples to hold the Secretary of State and election officials accountable. **Election integrity is not just a talking point** , having confidence in our elections is the foundation of our great Republic, and I will not stand to see it undermined. |
| |
|
---
[SUBMIT A TIP TO TIFFANY’S TIPLINE](https://88783.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/2qQtGl3Zs3oKIKfqA71RwffR8h3MHnWiuW9EyMlrmyq0qQ_QTKSDYWI1IwjfKuswER4mXGJKNMGlsoaKAzBsTbEBes1a7eBGkxQ4BGg8x3jpQspMXLydVceBU7-I2yhiGKkJ76wEuy_4aIxgV7A7IxRxseC3q5QuQNaQnlv4lvgGXkdR5KwTQiFYt4owHYP5Fj62VtrfC8QR00Zeh6tK4rs)

| | |
---|---|---
| I will not allow election officials to ignore this issue or try to put a bandage on the problem and call it a day. I will fight for votes tooth and nail to ensure that every legal vote cast is counted. Thank you for your continued support, |

clean_body: How Pinal County disenfranchised thousands of rural voters | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | July 21, 2022 | | | | ---|---|--- | Several weeks ago, my family and I received our new Pinal County-issued voter ID cards. Before ballots were even mailed, I noticed they had listed our address in Casa Grande instead of Eloy. I knew then that this mistake was going to affect more voters than just me. I immediately brought this to the attention of Pinal County election officials. Instead of correcting the mistake, however, we were told to not contact election officials by the deputy county attorney. Incorrect voter ID cards were a warning but only just the beginning of Pinal County’s broken voting rolls. When my son received a ballot that included a Casa Grande city council race, I was in shock. But then I learned that this very thing was happening to thousands of voters in Apache Junction, Casa Grande, Eloy, Mammoth, Maricopa, Queen Creek, and Superior. Pinal County admitted that it sent 65,000 voters incomplete ballots and an unknown number of ballots to voters listing municipal races they are not eligible for. When my husband and I voted in person I also received an incorrect ballot that had Casa Grande City Council Races on it. To date the address on my voter ID card and voter registration has not been corrected. The Pinal County spokesman blamed the issue on human errors. But I’m left wondering if they took my complaint seriously weeks ago, would this issue have been avoided? Their arrogance told me all I needed to know— this was going to be an absolute disaster. Pinal County ignored our complaints. They need to be held accountable. This grave mistake is incompetence at best, voter disenfranchisement at its worst.My open message to Pinal County—and every county—elections don’t belong to the government, they belong to the people. This is not a Democrat or Republican issue, this hurts everyone. It is an incomprehensibly huge disaster to both receive a ballot for an election that you are not qualified to vote in and be denied your lawful right to vote in your own city’s elections. I still remember being called crazy for having legitimate concerns about the security of our elections. But now it’s happening, again. So, I’m sounding the alarm. We can’t afford to sit by and let indignant election officials dismiss our concerns out of hand and damage what is left of our confidence in our elections. After being told to stop my inquiries by Pinal County, I filed an online complaint with the Attorney General’s Office and the Election Integrity Unit. Without civil subpoena power, I’m concerned that they will have little recourse to investigate this mess. That’s where you come in. If you’re an Arizona voter and have election issues, drop us a tip and we’ll amplify your voice. I’m setting up a website, “”, so I can compile a list of concrete examples to hold the Secretary of State and election officials accountable. Election integrity is not just a talking point , having confidence in our elections is the foundation of our great Republic, and I will not stand to see it undermined. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | I will not allow election officials to ignore this issue or try to put a bandage on the problem and call it a day. I will fight for votes tooth and nail to ensure that every legal vote cast is counted. Thank you for your continued support, | | | | | | | | | ---|--- | | | ---|---|--- | Tiffany Shedd | | | | | | | | | | | Primary Date: August 2 Early Voting: July 6-29 Poll Hours: 6am - 7pm Absentee/Mail-In Deadline: July 26 | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | Tiffany Shedd for Attorney General | PO Box 92, Eloy, AZ 85131 |

Team —

We were planning on emailing you today to tell you that Sara co-led a bill that would protect access to contraception. **But before we had a chance to send it, Sara presided over the bill passing in the House!**

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220721&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220721&amount=28]
Team,
The ‘dark money’ is already flowing in for Elissa’s opponent. So what does that mean exactly? And how does it really impact campaigns? Here’s an example:
An out-of-state Super PAC called Americans for Prosperity Action has a special interest in Elissa’s opponent. Because it’s a Super PAC, it's easy to hide who's funding them -- our campaign finance system allows them to hide their donors, and how much they give. A person or corporation could spend millions of dollars, and the public may never know.
You may recognize the name Americans for Prosperity – it’s the major project funded by David and Charles Koch. They’ve been pouring money into conservative candidates and causes, such as fighting back against minimum wage increases, for over a decade.
This group has identified Elissa’s opponent as a politician to invest in. He’s on their farm team – they’ve invested early, bankrolling ads across his district as far back as 2014 when he very first ran for State House. They had his back again with ads in his run for State Senate, and now, they’re back again for his run for Congress.
When he votes the way AFP likes, he sees major spending on his behalf.
For example:
AFP came out against the deal that’s enabling GM to build a new electric vehicle battery plant in the 7th district (creating thousands of jobs in the process) on the day it was announced. Elissa’s opponent voted against the deal, and not long after, they endorsed his campaign.
And then, they started to spend money, spending $40,000 just in the past few months. That money has gone to canvassing the new district — meaning people paid to knock on doors, giving the appearance of grassroots volunteers — digital ads, and door-hangers, which we’ve already seen popping up.
But here’s the thing: this is just the start. These outside groups can spend *unlimited* amounts of money supporting whichever candidates they see fit – as long as they don’t technically coordinate with the campaign.
How do we plan to combat this kind of large-scale outside spending? The same way we always have – with the grassroots support of actual people who believe in Elissa. That’s why we’re asking that you chip in today to help us fight back against outside money and spread Elissa’s message to the new 7th district. Dear friend, **I want to take this opportunity to thank you for your friendship, support, encouragement, and belief in our collective effort to make Maryland the state where you and your family would want to live and thrive.** Obviously, the results of the Governor’s race were personally very disappointing. For me, the outcome brings to a close 46 years in politics and elected office, though not my life-long desire to serve others. I deeply appreciate the hundreds of emails, texts and calls that I have received since the polls closed. Many of you referenced the “man in the arena” passage from President Teddy Roosevelt’s “Citizenship in a Republic” speech delivered at the Sorbonne in 1910, a year after he left office, in which he preaches the need to be better as people. **As I exit this arena, I will dust myself off and look toward new ways in which I can contribute toward making Maryland a better place.** While we fought valiantly over the past year for the opportunity to make Maryland and its signature city of Baltimore a safe and just place, to protect our planet from climate change, to be a brick wall in protecting abortion rights, and to spark economic turnaround, the voters went a different direction. **“The World Burns While Joe Manchin Makes Bank”** _-Esquire_

Manchin has made millions off of the coal industry and lined his pockets with campaign contributions from the energy industry as well. He is tanking the core and moderate Biden-approved social, economic, and environmental policies that are the bare minimum of what we need to survive.
We must fight to transform the party, protect the Squad, and expand our bloc of Justice Democrats in Congress to advance critical progressive policies like a Green New Deal to combat the climate crisis.

| | **Friend, above all else, I am and will forever be a parent first.** My three kids are well into their adult years, but I still think about them every minute of every day. As a mother, I _always_ worry about their safety — especially right now. There hasn’t been a **single week** in 2022 without a mass shooting. Our schools, our grocery stores, _even our holiday parades_ are not safe from the gun violence epidemic spreading throughout our country. _Enough is enough._ It’s time to enact common-sense gun laws and condemn the permitless carry bills legislators like my opponent have tried to pass. It’s time to mandate background checks and red flag laws, and it’s time to stop sending wishes for peace without any meaningful course of action. **[If you’re ready to join my fight to enact common-sense gun reform, sign my petition today so we can send D.C. the message: Our communities need action, not empty platitudes.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48144131/357073912/1715611728?refcode=em_220721_guncontrol&sourceid=1031507&ms=em_220721_guncontrol&refcode2=08023ce4-3309-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODAyM2NlNC0zMzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=03ijaEKv7WgpIGwNJQ7R82YOK4sD4Y9ZIxvq5rPgtf8=&emci=416dd29c-2509-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=08023ce4-3309-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=17998091)** | [SIGN ON »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48144133/357073914/1715611728?refcode=em_220721_guncontrol&sourceid=1031507&ms=em_220721_guncontrol&refcode2=08023ce4-3309-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODAyM2NlNC0zMzA5LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=03ijaEKv7WgpIGwNJQ7R82YOK4sD4Y9ZIxvq5rPgtf8=&emci=416dd29c-2509-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=08023ce4-3309-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=17998091)

clean_body: Our communities need action, not empty platitudes. | = | | Friend, above all else, I am and will forever be a parent first. My three kids are well into their adult years, but I still think about them every minute of every day. As a mother, I always worry about their safety — especially right now. There hasn’t been a single week in 2022 without a mass shooting. Our schools, our grocery stores, even our holiday parades are not safe from the gun violence epidemic spreading throughout our country. Enough is enough. It’s time to enact common-sense gun laws and condemn the permitless carry bills legislators like my opponent have tried to pass. It’s time to mandate background checks and red flag laws, and it’s time to stop sending wishes for peace without any meaningful course of action. | Our children — and our communities — deserve leadership who cares more about their safety than their rating from the NRA. As your next congresswoman, I promise I’ll fight like only a mother can to end the vicious cycle of gun violence throughout our country. Thanks for your support, friend. body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=530%2E5257348%2EaS0BfV ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek,

The NRA is terrified that my legislation holding gun manufacturers and gun
dealers liable for the negligent deaths they cause is about to pass in the
House — so they are going full tilt to smear me and undermine our efforts:

“U.S. House Sets its Sights on Destroying the American Firearms Industry”
— NRA Institute for Legislative Action, 7/20/22

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2022_abs_em.4MLSU6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20220721_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=530%2E5257348%2EaS0BfV ]If you’re ready to help my campaign push back forcefully against the
NRA’s attacks and get my bill passed, chip in now. If you want to hear
more first, please read on. This is important.

President Biden has called my legislation to repeal the gun industry’s
legal immunity from civil lawsuits his greatest priority in tackling gun
violence. And there’s good reason.

The NRA and gun manufacturers have repeatedly proven that they don’t care
about wanton violence or senseless gun deaths. To them, it’s all about
their bottom line — dollars and cents from more gun sales, more
fear-mongering, and more assault weapons on the street. It lines their
pockets.

So I’m excited to share with you today that last night, the House
Judiciary Committee passed my bill, the Equal Access to Justice for
Victims of Gun Violence Act, through the committee. It could come to the
House floor as early as next week. Not a single Republican voted for it.

Let me tell you why that matters:

Since 2005, the Protection of Lawful Commerce in Arms Act, or PLCAA for
short, has given the multibillion-dollar gun industry a legal immunity
that no other industry enjoys.

That means that survivors of gun violence and victims’ families have had
no legal recourse for the bloodshed our country has experienced with
everyday gun violence and mass shootings for almost two decades. The gun
industry can act with negligent disregard for the public safety and there
is no holding them accountable.

Consequently, the gun industry has had no incentive to stem the flow of
firearms into the wrong hands. Even if they end up killing children in a
school.

My legislation would repeal PLCAA, remove the gun industry’s legal
immunity, and open them up to civil suits to hold them accountable for
their negligence and the harm they have caused to tens of thousands of
people and families.

That’s exactly why the NRA is coming after me with their full force — they
even said “the mere fact that such extreme legislation is even being
considered shows how far current House leadership would like to go in its
war on the Second Amendment.”

We need to respond and keep pushing for the changes our country
desperately needs, but we need to keep our House majority past November to
do it.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2022_abs_em.4MLSU6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20220721_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=530%2E5257348%2EaS0BfV ]Please, Derek, rush a donation today to help us respond to
the NRA’s attacks and hold the gun industry accountable with my
legislation. We’ve got them on their heels and need to keep pushing.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=jul2022_abs_em.ilu4SR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20220721_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=530%2E5257348%2EaS0BfV ]EXPRESS DONATE $10

This weeks’ polls show the Biden Administration
accomplished a new feat — his approval rating dropped to an
embarrassing 29%, with nearly twice as many people thinking he’s
incompetent to do the job Democrats elected him to do!

Historical Low Ratings

These are the lowest approval ratings of any president at this
point in their presidency — ever. It’s not that hard to believe,
though...the world is falling apart around us.

* The Biden Administration is inviting illegal
immigrants to flood across our border, as more of our young
people are dying of fentanyl connected to the drug cartels;

* Gas prices and inflation are stretching Americans’ budgets
tighter than ever;

* Outrageous housing and energy costs are pushing seniors and
families closer and closer to homelessness;

* Crime is on the rise, while Biden and Democrats in Congress are
still working to defund our police.

Failure of Leadership - Disastrous Policies
================================================
Biden’s record-breaking failures and his
record-low approval ratings beg the question: how does one mess
up this badly, if not on purpose? Americans overwhelmingly think
the country is heading in the wrong direction, and yet Biden is
doubling down on his disastrous policies:

* A recently uncovered voicemail cast doubt on
the President’s original assertion that he had no involvement in
his son’s business dealings.

* He drained our emergency strategic oil reserves to sell it to
China, but he’s refusing to greenlight the Keystone Pipeline and
ramp up domestic energy production.

* Biden is coordinating a massive effort to mobilize Congress to
pass sweeping abortion legislation that would undermine the Supreme
Court’s landmark decision this month.

The list goes on and on.

This Is Our Opportunity

November is coming! We don’t just need to best vulnerable
Democrats, we need to win every election possible to build the
most powerful conservative majority in 30 years and take the
Speaker’s gavel away from Nancy Pelosi.

Now is the time for Republicans all over the country to link arms

name: Peter Welch
subject: This is outrageous and disappointing, but it is also unsurprising
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
The recent EPA decision makes it that much clearer that we need urgent action by states, and by Congress, to protect Americans’ basic rights—including the right to a livable planet.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=693%2E61531%2E05tCFz)
Hello,
At the end of its term, the Supreme Court issued their ruling in _West Virginia v. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)_ , which essentially guts the authority of the EPA to mandate carbon emissions reductions.
Here’s why that’s a big deal: The EPA’s ability to force electricity generators to shift to cleaner options is a key tool for the federal government to keep our environment safe and to reduce carbon pollution. Once again, the conservative Supreme Court has dealt a blow to the critical work of our government, the health of all Americans, and the safety of our planet for future generations.
**I refuse to let this ruling deter us in our fight to address the climate crisis. Congress must take action—now.[ So I’m asking: Will you chip in $5 or anything you can to build a movement for a Green New Deal and urgent climate action?](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3509?t=3&akid=693%2E61531%2E05tCFz)**
[CHIP IN ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3509?t=8&t=9&akid=693%2E61531%2E05tCFz)
---
Every American—no matter who they voted for—has benefited from the EPA’s work to ensure clean air, safe drinking water, and a sustainable planet. Make no mistake: the Court hasn’t simply ruled against the EPA. They’ve ruled in favor of corporate polluters over the public good.
**The Court is putting Americans in danger. It’s outrageous. It’s disappointing. But it’s also unsurprising.**
The Supreme Court is no longer a non-partisan arbiter. It has been carved into an intensely conservative body, working on behalf of an extreme right-wing agenda, against the will of the American people. **This decision makes it that much clearer that we need urgent action by states, and by Congress, to protect Americans’ basic rights—including the right to a livable planet.**
[**A contribution from you today would send a powerful message that we’re nowhere near done fighting. Please chip in to help fight corporate polluters and pass a Green New Deal.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3509?t=4&akid=693%2E61531%2E05tCFz)
**There’s no doubt about it: if we continue on this path, marginalized communities will suffer the most damage.** A Green New Deal will reduce greenhouse gas emissions and help us avoid the worst consequences of climate change while also tackling economic inequality and racial injustice. That’s why I was proud to be an original cosponsor of the Green New Deal alongside Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
I’ve brought members of Congress together to deliver results before—even against powerful interests like fossil fuel corporations. From leading climate and green energy legislation in the House, to joining climate marches with environmental leaders, climate action has been a cause near and dear to me for decades. And I don’t intend to slow down as senator: I’ll continue working towards a more just and sustainable future that advances clean energy, while creating good-paying and equitable green jobs.
**We can still create a future where future generations thrive. But only if we work together.**
[**Chip in anything you can to help us build a movement for a Green New Deal and meaningful climate action that can stand up to even the highest court in the land.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3509?t=5&akid=693%2E61531%2E05tCFz)
Thanks for making this possible,
Peter

body:
To honor his deep New Jersey roots, I thought it would be a GREAT idea to start a petition.
#
Hi Derek, it's John Fetterman.
We all know Dr. Oz is _soooooo_ proud to be Jersey Strong 💪TM️
He’s a huge New Jersey celebrity who’s lived there for three decades.
Clearly, Dr. Oz loves his home state. I mean, the dude is even registered to vote in NJ and voted there as recently as 2020.
**So, to honor Dr. Oz’s deep New Jersey roots, I thought it would be a GREAT idea to start a petition + help him reach his dream of being inducted into the New Jersey Hall of Fame.**
[**_Will you sign your name to support adding Oz to the New Jersey Hall of Fame? Help us recognize his Jersey Pride by signing our petition today._**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-nj-hall-of-fame/?source=em20220721-6597&t=1&akid=6597%2E434096%2EjvBNL4)
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-nj-hall-of-fame/?source=em20220721-6597&t=2&akid=6597%2E434096%2EjvBNL4)
How do I know that being inducted into the New Jersey hall of fame is Dr. Oz’s DREAM?
He said so himself as a presenter at the 2019 New Jersey Hall of Fame Awards.
When asked on the red carpet who should be inducted into the NJ Hall of Fame in the future, he literally said:
> **_“Great surgeons! [laughter]”_** 🤡
I’m not joking. This *actually* happened.
**So uhhh if you think Dr. Oz being in the NJ Hall of Fame makes *way* more sense than him running for Senate in PA...**
[**_Sign our petition to support Dr. Oz joining the New Jersey Hall of Fame!!!_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-nj-hall-of-fame/?source=em20220721-6597&t=3&akid=6597%2E434096%2EjvBNL4)

—John

name: CheriBeasley.com
subject: Add your name: Demand the Senate pass the Respect for Marriage Act.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
The law would create federal protections for same-sex and interracial marriage.
#

Team -
This week, the House of Representatives passed the Respect for Marriage Act by a large bipartisan majority.
The law would create federal protections for same-sex and interracial marriage, and Cheri Beasley is calling on the U.S. Senate to take this bill up for a vote and pass it quickly. Can you join her?
[**Add your name: Tell the Senate to pass the Respect for Marriage Act to protect same-sex and interracial marriage. With our rights at risk, we owe it to families to defend their freedom to marry the person they love.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/respect_for_marriage_act_petition/?source=em220721-2-MA&akid=1283%2E357359%2EszA_AE)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/respect_for_marriage_act_petition/?source=em220721-2-MA&akid=1283%2E357359%2EszA_AE)**
When the Supreme Court overturned _Roe_ , one of the opinions suggested that they should overturn same-sex marriage next.
This politicized Supreme Court majority and Washington Republicans are taking aim at our constitutional rights. That’s why this action is so urgent.
Despite the bipartisan vote in the House, **our opponent, Rep. Ted Budd, voted against this bill.** He does not believe same-sex and interracial couples deserve protection — making clear once again that he is too extreme for North Carolina.
But that’s why we cannot take these rights for granted. The Senate must move swiftly to enshrine these fundamental freedoms into law.
[**Please add your name to Cheri’s today to demand the Senate pass the Respect for Marriage Act to protect same-sex and interracial marriage.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/respect_for_marriage_act_petition/?source=em220721-2-MA&akid=1283%2E357359%2EszA_AE)
Cheri is a former judge who has spent over two decades protecting our rights, and she will never hesitate to stand up for equality and justice for all. She knows we all should have equal protection under the law — no matter what.
\- Team Beasley
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/respect_for_marriage_act_petition/?source=em220721-2-MA&akid=1283%2E357359%2EszA_AE)**

Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
PO Box 28778
Raleigh, NC 27611
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you want to receive fewer emails, you may [submit this form to get only our most important updates](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=1&akid=1283%2E357359%2EszA_AE). Emails like this are a critical tool for our campaign's fundraising and organizing efforts, but if you need to, you can [unsubscribe here](https://act.cheribeasley.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=2&akid=1283%2E357359%2EszA_AE). If you would like to support Cheri's campaign for the U.S. Senate in North Carolina, please consider [making a donation](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beasley-em-2021?refcode=em-footer&t=3&refcode2=1283_357359_szA_AE&akid=1283%2E357359%2EszA_AE) today to help us make history.

Let me get right to the point: this year’s Democratic primaries are seeing an unprecedented avalanche of right wing and corporate Super PAC spending. | | | Peter —

Let me get right to the point: **this year’s Democratic primaries are seeing an unprecedented avalanche of right wing and corporate Super PAC spending.**

And we’re at serious risk of those right wing forces shifting the balance of the Democratic Caucus in a much more conservative and pro-corporate direction and putting our entire agenda at risk — unless we’re prepared to answer it.

Because you’re such a valued supporter of the Working Families Party, Peter, I wanted to take a moment to share some more detail with you about this threat we are facing and how we are proving we can fight back and win. But before I do: **_[Can you contribute to our Working Families Majority Fund to help us reach more voters every day from now through Election Day? We’ve got critical primaries in more than a dozen states over the next two months, and then we’ve got to fight for — and win — majorities in the House and Senate that will actually pass our priorities into law.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU12hoC5E2SU6lPDcuPSOuVhBTU-q4FtEYXEBz6yQug4BYjWc8yryFQdS7UVrbyrugObKmBLFOWkGxTw1RF3Q3AvAQOH34LtqAV2Uob1-RjfGcAuQPx32jERj6AwwDW7r75COYfk17IS8ihD77RgrMW8wfrb1LtUi0NLY_URkmsC_ah1pIrx3jWAat_6I_GXDD9xYi-917SWMOPoaSWx4HO2KaXPHBmnOPRMdqAWju0FRstEUU-QVyRLf0yW7FkNDJPwX6FM-iZqLaxIqiSvy96__9S6_AF1dKng50KJ7E4ySb9mUwwMc5e8VcO8Z8Cfcq/3nx/OLU2AG0vRk2VJpnoGPAe0A/h0/_6RMVV3e1pd1fklgEe6iMUXVC1-db-yik1H9qRzAGBU)_** **[Contribute $6 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU12hoC5E2SU6lPDcuPSOuVhBTU-q4FtEYXEBz6yQug4BYjWc8yryFQdS7UVrbyrugo0d9HVYz0dJMgLlsStXlqCUZz8C6BjGJhrqAKkfUDqwhxdsDIw_ijm4dgkkN0oNpY4TWFyna7H5Gy5OlFq_o_7WjXsrh7BK1RMV_2V8qsrN1XTAXZm2pH6lebUEW5VLx8W0Q19xVXxMjqgM8YSch7G81LDIBimSQhzteXmHk8P7meDrZjJp4sbP4JbPpZpZ0ExjvXJai2C5utmBeyvlzagyIhvsC7D4U2MTFQqpYzbHNyhG-7v68RbIBlGSI_VEE/3nx/OLU2AG0vRk2VJpnoGPAe0A/h1/ln-quT7t6mW0xLOIhh-zCGQlsxTAwgsttcaN9RIhp_U)** First, some numbers:
* This year already, FEC reports show that more than _$90 million dollars_ has been spent in outside spending in Democratic primaries for the U.S. House.
* _Twenty_ separate Democratic primaries have seen independent spending over $1 million so far.
* The biggest new conservative spender this cycle is AIPAC’s super PAC, called the “United Democracy Project” or UDP. They’ve spent roughly _$20 million_ in Democratic primaries so far this cycle alone.

**Numbers like that have been unheard of until this cycle.** And even as AIPAC and their allies are spending multiple millions in Democratic primaries, they are also endorsing more than 100 insurrectionist Republicans for Congress.

But it’s not only the issue of foreign policy that will get yanked to the right if AIPAC wins – **it’s everything.** Our working families agenda is particularly at risk. Consider some of the biggest races they’ve spent in already:
* In Texas, UDP spent millions to defend **Henry Cuellar** , the only anti-abortion Democrat in Congress who also got an “A” rating from the NRA, against his progressive challenger **Jessica Cisneros**. Their millions pushed him over the top in a race that came down to a recount.
* In Maryland, UDP spent over _$6 million_ in one race alone to defeat **Donna Edwards** , a former progressive member of Congress with nearly a dozen union endorsements — all so they could elect a former corporate lobbyist who represented tech and telecom corporations.

We know that working people running for office will never be able to match this kind of spending. But we also know money isn’t everything — and we’ve already seen what is possible this cycle when our candidates have the resources to get their own message out and fight back:
* In Pennsylvania, WFP-endorsed progressive state legislator **Summer Lee** was able to overcome attacks from UDP and narrowly win her race against corporate Democrat **Steve Irwin**.
* In Oregon, WFP’s **Jamie McLeod-Skinner** was able to handily defeat **Kurt Schrader** , a budget-hawk Blue Dog who played a central role in derailing Biden’s Build Back Better bill and also killed the Democrats’ prescription drug reform bill in Committee, despite corporate PACs spending big for him.

**Midway through the Democratic primary season in 2022, what we’re seeing so far is more than a coincidence. It is a pattern.**

Some of the biggest donors to AIPAC’s super PAC are Republican titans of industry, including hedge fund manager and “vulture capitalist” Paul Singer and Home Depot founder Bernie Marcus. Their opposition to the strength and political power of our movement is surely at least part of what they think they’re getting out of their political spending.

We’ve learned from this cycle that progressives can get outspent and still win. But it’s one thing to be outspent 2-1 and something else altogether to get outspent 5-1 or 10-1 — and it is that kind of lopsided resource advantage that dark money groups are looking to bring to bear to defeat champions of working people.

There’s still time to alter the dynamics in the races that are in the weeks ahead and make sure WFP candidates have what they need to get their own message out to voters.
**_[We’ve shown that we can take on big corporate money and win — but only when we pool our resources together. Chip in to our Working Families Majority Fund to help us elect more champions to office who will be accountable to working people and not right-wing megadonors.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU12hoC5E2SU6lPDcuPSOuVhBTU-q4FtEYXEBz6yQug4BYjWc8yryFQdS7UVrbyrug_dKnJxNLKRTBg1cFf7-mCd1gtFlckpJbeqx3HpCkqmpykdBjZ0Y3JmhyGhbEjK0aRC7WVuAJoJ4a5vEPWYTnAKeb8G4_Ni-bL7LCOQGLWMqk903OdRNSaAsS7dxzY3AHhx3fjs0dpwOyXMShSj8CbCeDXvAta8pJsLUmY6TePXHtyx0Hq39qE0XEv0jfMeHCE1sKoEDb6VZfPxy-eZFsTJYJZSvLOLJ8oXuFvA-8QnA8UzZrdSJNZFHgeC1FVQrd/3nx/OLU2AG0vRk2VJpnoGPAe0A/h2/nf_glYgt-1WfVQYW6bW2dVOG3LmTutlTb1qaKj-i8Ek)_** In solidarity,

clean_body: Let me get right to the point: this year’s Democratic primaries are seeing an unprecedented avalanche of right wing and corporate Super PAC spending. | | | Peter — Let me get right to the point: this year’s Democratic primaries are seeing an unprecedented avalanche of right wing and corporate Super PAC spending. And we’re at serious risk of those right wing forces shifting the balance of the Democratic Caucus in a much more conservative and pro-corporate direction and putting our entire agenda at risk — unless we’re prepared to answer it. Because you’re such a valued supporter of the Working Families Party, Peter, I wanted to take a moment to share some more detail with you about this threat we are facing and how we are proving we can fight back and win. But before I do: First, some numbers: This year already, FEC reports show that more than $90 million dollars has been spent in outside spending in Democratic primaries for the U.S. House. Twenty separate Democratic primaries have seen independent spending over $1 million so far. The biggest new conservative spender this cycle is AIPAC’s super PAC, called the “United Democracy Project” or UDP. They’ve spent roughly $20 million in Democratic primaries so far this cycle alone. Numbers like that have been unheard of until this cycle. And even as AIPAC and their allies are spending multiple millions in Democratic primaries, they are also endorsing more than 100 insurrectionist Republicans for Congress. But it’s not only the issue of foreign policy that will get yanked to the right if AIPAC wins – it’s everything. Our working families agenda is particularly at risk. Consider some of the biggest races they’ve spent in already: In Texas, UDP spent millions to defend Henry Cuellar , the only anti-abortion Democrat in Congress who also got an “A” rating from the NRA, against his progressive challenger Jessica Cisneros. Their millions pushed him over the top in a race that came down to a recount. In Maryland, UDP spent over $6 million in one race alone to defeat Donna Edwards , a former progressive member of Congress with nearly a dozen union endorsements — all so they could elect a former corporate lobbyist who represented tech and telecom corporations. We know that working people running for office will never be able to match this kind of spending. But we also know money isn’t everything — and we’ve already seen what is possible this cycle when our candidates have the resources to get their own message out and fight back: In Pennsylvania, WFP-endorsed progressive state legislator Summer Lee was able to overcome attacks from UDP and narrowly win her race against corporate Democrat Steve Irwin. In Oregon, WFP’s Jamie McLeod-Skinner was able to handily defeat Kurt Schrader , a budget-hawk Blue Dog who played a central role in derailing Biden’s Build Back Better bill and also killed the Democrats’ prescription drug reform bill in Committee, despite corporate PACs spending big for him. Midway through the Democratic primary season in 2022, what we’re seeing so far is more than a coincidence. It is a pattern. Some of the biggest donors to AIPAC’s super PAC are Republican titans of industry, including hedge fund manager and “vulture capitalist” Paul Singer and Home Depot founder Bernie Marcus. Their opposition to the strength and political power of our movement is surely at least part of what they think they’re getting out of their political spending. We’ve learned from this cycle that progressives can get outspent and still win. But it’s one thing to be outspent 2-1 and something else altogether to get outspent 5-1 or 10-1 — and it is that kind of lopsided resource advantage that dark money groups are looking to bring to bear to defeat champions of working people. There’s still time to alter the dynamics in the races that are in the weeks ahead and make sure WFP candidates have what they need to get their own message out to voters. clean_body: Michelle attended and spoke at the Texas Democratic Convention last week! We want to share some pictures with you. | | | Peter, Michelle attended and spoke at the Texas Democratic Convention last week!**** It was incredible to see Michelle take the stage and talk about our mission to keep fighting for our home in Congress and a new vision for our future together. She was also able to collaborate with other candidates across the state that are focused on changing Texas to work for working people, like our Progressive Slate members Greg Casar and Jasmine Crockett. Michelle stood by allies in the fight for reproductive justice and took time to urge President Biden to take action to allow medication abortions via telehealth. She took the time to address caucus members and supporters, so they could hear our plans to make Texas a place that works for ALL of us. This was an incredible experience for Michelle and our entire team. It showed us just how much we can do when Democrats in Texas stand together for the people. | | Good news...

I'm in the process of drafting my first bill to introduce in the January session...

The purpose... prohibiting Idaho banks & businesses from using E.S.G. ratings (i.e. Chinese-type social credit scores being pushed by the World Economic Forum) as a discriminatory practice against individual citizens.

This is in concurrence with:

SENATE BILL NO. 1405 that passed last year: [https://legislature.idaho.gov/.../2022/legislation/S1405.pdf](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=186f5367bc&e=dea908e0fe)

HB 7373 introduced in March 2022 by Representative Ehardt: [https://legislature.idaho.gov/.../2022/legislation/H0737.pdf](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=5677c29563&e=dea908e0fe)

HCR 52 that sets the stage for a whole slew of anti-ESG legislation (this is really good, please read it): [https://legislature.idaho.gov/.../legislation/HCR052.pdf](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=3ebed07002&e=dea908e0fe)

So with this bill, I'm happy to take another step toward protecting Idaho citizens from corporate SJW wokeism.

More to come later, stay tuned.

Cheers,

Brian

**P.S. **If you don't know what E.S.G. is, [watch this](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=9216fe4950&e=dea908e0fe "Glenn Beck explains ESG").

**P.P.S.** the Idaho GOP conference was... interesting. We did a lot of good, but there was also some party poopers present trying to upset the apple cart. For a good synopsis of what happened, you can [check out this op-ed](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=f4590b60af&e=dea908e0fe "ID GOP Shenanigans ").

body:

---
| |
---
| | Friends,

I just wanted to give you a quick update on our campaign. We have been out and about talking to voters as much as possible and guess what? **Our message is resonating.** Connecticut is ready for a constitutional conservative to represent them in the Senate, and the momentum surrounding our campaign keeps growing.

Last Thursday I joined the East Hampton RTC at their booth and had a great time mingling with voters. It was great to see so many members of our law enforcement stop by the booth - as your Senator I will always stand with our police. Afterwords I joined the Northwestern Hills Republican Group's meeting.
---
|
---
| Saturday was filled with fun campaign stops as well. First we joined Bethel's "Shop and Stroll Event" where a RTC member set up a tent for candidates to hand out literature. Then we joined Connecticut for Trump's "Thank You President Trump" event at a gazebo in the center of Meriden.They even had me draw names from a hat to announce the winners of free tickets to Trump train ride in Essex on August 7th. We ended the day at Scotland RTC's meeting. On Sunday, I attended mass at Our Lady of Mount Carmel Roman Catholic Church and then joined the Litchfield HRCC event with State Rep. David Wilson.
---
|
---
| Monday I was honored to join my friend, Freddie Rizvani, for his restaurant opening at "The Mill House Kitchen and Bar" in Torrington, and joined the Southington RTC meeting after. I also was was invited to speak on Newsmax about the damage Joe Biden and the Democrats are doing to our country. If you missed it you can check it out below. Finally, on Tuesday I was able to join the Westport RTC meeting.
---
| [ ](https://PeterLumaj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e4fb4f1b85edd41e1d869424a&id=691b109a50&e=ad1669c4a3)
---
We NEED to do something about gas prices
| A\s a final note - I'd like to ask you all to take a moment to pray for my opponent in the Republican Primary, Themis Klarides and her family. While Themis and I have many disagreements on policy - I understand that her mother passed away just a few days ago. I hope God can lead her and her family through this trying time, and I look forward to continuing our debate about the direction of the country when she returns to the campaign trail.

In Service,

Peter Lumaj

P.S. We are coming down to the wire - and our team needs your help getting our message out to the voters. If you could [chip in a generous gift of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 it'd make a world of difference](https://PeterLumaj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e4fb4f1b85edd41e1d869424a&id=75acaaa736&e=ad1669c4a3) over the next few weeks. This campaign has been a blessing, and I'm honored to have all of you on my team.
---

| | | Dear Peter,

Tonight, America will be tuned into the live proceedings of the _House Select Committee to Investigate the January 6th Attack_. Viewers will again hear explosive testimony laying out the treasonous actions of former President Trump as he attempted to dismantle our democracy and overturn a free and fair election that was decided by the American people.

**As California Assembly Speaker pro Tem, I’ve authored and passed landmark laws that have become models for the nation to safeguard our democracy, and you can bet that I’ll do the same in Congress.[ Peter](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=cffd9bdcc0&e=292fde286a)****[, can you chip in $25, $50, or $100 to help get me there in November?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=26fbadd1d9&e=292fde286a)**

In Sacramento, I wrote the landmark _DISCLOSE Act_ , one of the nation’s toughest laws to ban dark money in our state elections. I passed the state’s first all vote-by-mail election, leading to record-breaking turnout and voter participation, and co-authored California’s groundbreaking automatic voter registration bill to make it easier for every Californian to participate in their own democracy. This is why Congresswoman Jackie Speier was the first to endorse my campaign to fill her shoes in Congress.

**Across our nation, right-wing Trump Republicans are already planning for the next election, working to restrict access to the ballot and subvert our democratic process. We must stop them in their tracks.[ Click here to pitch in $25, $50, or $100 to send a proven progressive to Congress with the experience and track record to safeguard our democracy.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=1d960178f0&e=292fde286a) **

In solidarity,
Kevin Mullin
